title: Standortentwickler (m/w/d)
description: „Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“ Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter. Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig. Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest. Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis. Wer wir sind Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international. Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag. Deine Mission Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr: Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen. Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt. Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung. Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst. Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark. Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach. Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich. Was du mitbringst Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet. Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du weißt, wie Maßnahmen zugelassen, gefüllt, abgerechnet und geprüft werden. Geschäftstüchtigkeit – Du denkst wie eine Unternehmerin oder ein Unternehmer: Du erkennst Chancen, rechnest sie durch, entscheidest schnell und bringst sie auf die Straße. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut – einen Standort, ein Geschäftsfeld, ein Team oder ein Unternehmen. Vertriebsstärke – Du gehst auf Menschen zu, kommst ins Gespräch, überzeugst und schließt ab – bei Kostenträgern wie bei Geschäftsführungen. Führung – Du hast Teams aufgebaut und geführt und weißt, wie man aus Einzelpersonen eine Mannschaft macht. Zahlenverständnis – Budget, Deckungsbeitrag, Auslastung – du steuerst mit Kennzahlen und nicht nach Gefühl. Qualifikation – Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung – betriebswirtschaftlich, pädagogisch, sozial oder etwas ganz anderes. Entscheidend ist, was du bewegt hast. Persönlichkeit – Gründergeist, Ausdauer, Verbindlichkeit. Du hältst Unsicherheit aus, bleibst dran, wenn es zäh wird, und feierst, wenn der erste Teilnehmende einen Arbeitsvertrag unterschreibt. Was wir dir geben Gewinnbeteiligung – Du baust den Standort auf – und du bist am Gewinn beteiligt, den er erwirtschaftet. Die Details klären wir im Gespräch, offen und transparent. Freiheit – Du entscheidest vor Ort. Wir geben dir Ziele, keine Mikro-Anweisungen. Entscheidungen fallen bei uns schnell – 70 Prozent Informationslage reichen. Rückendeckung – Du startest nicht bei null: Zertifizierung und Qualitätsmanagement, erprobte Maßnahmenkonzepte, Verwaltung, Buchhaltung, Marketing und 15 Jahre Erfahrung im Ausschreibungsgeschäft stehen hinter dir. Direkter Draht – Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung der Gruppe zusammen – kurze Wege, schnelle Antworten. Perspektive – Wer Berlin aufbaut, leitet Berlin. Die Standortleitung ist der logische nächste Schritt. Sinn – Jeder Mensch, den dein Standort in Arbeit bringt, ist dein Ergebnis. Das sieht man – jeden Tag. Corporate Benefits und betriebliche Altersvorsorge – Weil wir auch an deine Zukunft denken. Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis Klingt nach dir? Dann erzähl uns in deiner Bewerbung vor allem eins: Was hast du schon aufgebaut – und wie würdest du in Berlin anfangen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Diese Stelle wird zentral von der IWQ Holding GmbH ausgeschrieben. Die Anstellung erfolgt bei der für den Standort Berlin zuständigen operativen Tochtergesellschaft der EuBiA-Gruppe. Bei uns zählt der Mensch: Bewerbungen sind unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, sexueller Identität oder einer Behinderung ausdrücklich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf dich! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Customer Success
description: At evenito, we build enterprise event management software centered on human connection. By combining cutting-edge technology with personal support, we empower event teams to automate routine logistics and free up time for what truly matters: crafting memorable, sustainable event experiences. As our Head of Customer Success (CS) you will have a front row seat. Together with your team you will be responsible for evenito’s customer excellence. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will not only ensure that our customers receive professional support, but also be the strategic business owner of our post-sale organization and act as a key customer voice within the company. You will develop and execute a scalable CS operating model and play a pivotal role in shaping our product and the future of evenito. Are you ready to make an impact? Your Mission: Drive customer success, develop a high-performing team and turn everyday user insights into strategic product growth. Lead by Example: You set the tone through your actions. From onboarding our largest enterprise clients (ICPs) to handling support tickets alongside your team, you showcase what great customer service looks like while equipping your team with the tools and support they need to succeed. Team Development & Coaching: You will lead and coach a team of five. Through regular 1-on-1s, clear goals and constructive feedback, you will foster a positive, supportive work environment focused on steady growth and a resilient team setup. Escalations & Problem Solving: You view complex situations as opportunities to build trust with our clients. When high-stakes issues arise, you partner directly with Product and Management to find clear solutions, using customer data to guide thoughtful decisions. Cross-Functional Advocacy: You serve as a key connector between our clients and internal teams. By sharing real customer insights with Product, Sales and Marketing, you help shape and prioritize our product roadmap while keeping team priorities aligned with company strategy. Process & Project Innovation: You stay current on Customer Success best practices and enjoy improving how things work. You will have the freedom to introduce new CS workflows that streamline daily operations and support our current growth stage. Commercial Impact & Growth: You ensure Customer Success is a growth engine by delivering clear, measurable value. You will drive product adoption and offer high-impact paid services, positioning expansions as a natural result of client success. This, while tracking performance with clear, business-focused metrics. Knowledge Base Development: You will own and champion our self-service tools (Knowledge Base, Video Academy, Automation). By making resources clear and accessible, you help our customers find quick answers independently and keep support queues manageable. Your Story You have a solid B2B SaaS experience, a practical doer mindset and a genuine drive to grow people and businesses - all fueled by a real enthusiasm for the magic of event tech. SaaS Experience: You bring 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation or Account Management in the B2B SaaS environment. Hands-on Doer Mindset: You keep your cool and stay positive when things go sideways. You are pragmatic, humble and jump into daily support queues without hesitation. Effective Communicator: You are a skilled communicator and workshop facilitator who connects effortlessly with enterprise executives, end-users and internal teams alike. Tech Savvy and Agile: You are at home analyzing usage data, mapping workflows and collaborating with Product on technical escalations. You adapt quickly to new software, shifting priorities and changing processes. Leadership Drive: You genuinely care about people. Ideally, you have led a small team before and take true fulfillment in coaching others, building confidence and helping your team grow. Passion for Events and Tech: Events are all about emotion and experience. We are looking for someone who brings that exact enthusiasm for events, event tech and / or digital products. Languages: Fluent in English and German, with the ability to comfortably follow Swiss-German in client meetings. What We Offer Unlock your full potential in an inspiring and fast-paced environment. We provide the stage; you take the reins. Impact : Take ownership of a role where your work directly shapes evenito's growth and sets new standards for the industry. You will work closely with management, an amazing team, passionate clients and drive projects that make a difference. Flexibility : As one of our core values, we strongly believe in hybrid remote work options and flexible schedules that allow you to align your professional commitments with your personal life. Time to Recharge : Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day off for every year of service, giving you plenty of time to rest and recharge. Modern Zurich HQ: Located just a five-minute walk from Zurich HB, our centrally located office offers an inspiring work environment with local coffee, a variety of snacks and access to many lunch spots. Unique Event s: Events are our DNA. Beyond building great software, we truly enjoy spending time with each other - whether through spontaneous summer swims in the Limmat-river, Friday Beer um Vier drinks, our annual Global Team Event or legendary Christmas parties. Mobility Support: We contribute toward your public transport pass (öV-Abo) to support convenient and sustainable commuting. Growth Potential: Thrive in a workplace with flat hierarchies, fast decision-making and an open feedback culture designed to help you continuously develop. Are you ready to shape the future of events with us? Discover more about life at evenito on our career page, send us your CV and tell us what excites you most about joining our team. We are building something special at evenito - and we can’t wait to meet the person behind the application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - Netherlands)
description: Our Vision & Products 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories. Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first . And we’re only just getting started! Our Team We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO. Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO] • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO] • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO] • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal] • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) Your Role We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms. You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform. This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol . You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow. Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression. Here’s what you can expect: Key Responsibilities Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement. Internally developed moderation technologies . Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs. Third-party safety partnerships and integrations . Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management. Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance . Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended. Red teaming and adversarial testing . Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report. Trust and safety reviews for new features . Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards. Incident follow-through and continuous improvement . Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support. Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub . Your Qualifications Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning; Content moderation and AI guardrails : You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting. Legal/safety work experience : You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product; Collaborative mindset and communication : You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English; AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them; You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture; You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process; You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content; Bonus points You have previous legal/compliance education Professional experience or interest in AI Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry Soft Skills 🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English) 🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment ⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy 🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback 🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit! Why EverAI? 📈 Exponentia

title: IT & Automation Specialist (m/w/d)
description: Über EVEREST Du sorgst dafür, dass IT einfach funktioniert – und machst sie noch ein bisschen smarter? Du kennst dich mit Microsoft 365 und macOS aus, löst technische Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft und hast Freude daran, Menschen zu unterstützen? Gleichzeitig denkst du gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und erkennst, wo sich Arbeitsabläufe durch Automatisierung und KI vereinfachen lassen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Bei EVEREST arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Entrepreneurship, AI und digitalen Produkten. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir Plattformen und Tools für Gründerinnen und Kleinunternehmerinnen – von der ersten Idee bis zum laufenden Produkt. Dazu gehören unter anderem die bundesweite, kostenlose Gründerplattform sowie das digitale Beratungsprogramm InStart für Soloselbstständige und Kleinunternehmen in der Krise in Hamburg. Unser Ziel: Menschen Zugang zu wirtschaftlichem Know-how, Kapital, Netzwerken und Ressourcen zu ermöglichen – und digitale Lösungen zu entwickeln, die sie dabei unterstützen, ihre unternehmerischen Ideen und Vorhaben erfolgreich umzusetzen. Wir sind ein kleines Team von ca. 35-40 Menschen mit vielfältigen Aufgaben und einer gemeinsamen Mission: Unternehmertum einfacher und zugänglicher machen. Damit unsere Kolleg*innen sich darauf konzentrieren können, brauchen wir eine IT, die zuverlässig läuft. Und jemanden, der nicht nur Probleme löst, sondern auch mitdenkt. Damit sich unsere Teams auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können, brauchen wir eine IT, die einfach funktioniert – sicher, zuverlässig und unkompliziert. Hier kommst du ins Spiel! Als IT & Automation Specialist betreust du gemeinsam mit unserer internen IT-Verantwortlichen unsere Microsoft-365- und Apple-Umgebung. Du bist Ansprechperson für technische Fragen, übernimmst eigene IT-Themen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kolleg*innen gut und sicher arbeiten können. Dabei möchten wir möglichst viel selbst in die Hand nehmen. Du bekommst deshalb den Freiraum, technische Lösungen eigenständig umzusetzen, bestehende Prozesse zu verbessern und neue Möglichkeiten durch Automatisierung und KI zu erschließen. Bei komplexeren Themen steht uns ein externer IT-Dienstleister zur Seite. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Hamburg-Altstadt suchen wir dich in Teilzeit ab 20 Wochenstunden. Ein höherer Stundenumfang ist nach Absprache möglich. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Hamburg-Altstadt suchen wir dich in Teilzeit ab 20 Wochenstunden. Ein höherer Stundenumfang ist nach Absprache möglich. Das erwartet dich Du sorgst für einen reibungslosen IT-Alltag: Microsoft 365 administrieren : Du betreust und optimierst unsere Microsoft-365-Umgebung mit Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint und Intune – von der Benutzer- und Rechteverwaltung über Lizenzen bis zu Sicherheitskonfigurationen. IT-Support mit echtem Servicegedanken: Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kolleg*innen bei technischen Fragen und Problemen. Im 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support findest du pragmatische Lösungen, erklärst verständlich und sorgst für einen möglichst unkomplizierten Arbeitsalltag. Onboarding & Offboarding begleiten : Du richtest Arbeitsgeräte, Benutzerkonten und Zugänge ein und stellst sicher, dass technisch vom ersten bis zum letzten Arbeitstag alles passt. Unsere Apple-Umgebung betreuen: Wir stellen zunehmend auf MacBooks um. Du begleitest diesen Prozess und kümmerst dich um die Einrichtung, Verwaltung und Absicherung unserer Geräte über Apple Business Manager und Microsoft Intune. Und du gestaltest unsere digitale Zukunft mit: Prozesse smarter machen: Du sprichst mit unseren Teams, analysierst ihre Arbeitsabläufe und erkennst, wo sich Aufgaben vereinfachen oder automatisieren lassen. Mit Power Automate, Make oder vergleichbaren Tools setzt du passende Lösungen eigenständig um. Neue Technologien sinnvoll einsetzen: Ob KI-gestützte Workflows, intelligente Assistenten oder neue Schnittstellen – du hast Lust, Möglichkeiten auszuprobieren und dort einzusetzen, wo sie einen echten Mehrwert bieten. Das bringen du mit Du bist technisch versiert, arbeitest gerne eigenständig und hast ein echtes Gespür dafür, wie gute IT den Arbeitsalltag erleichtert. Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der IT-Administration mit und kennst dich insbesondere mit Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online und Intune aus. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit macOS und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung mit der zentralen Verwaltung von Apple-Geräten. Du hast Erfahrung im 1st- und 2nd-Level-IT-Support und gehst technische Herausforderungen strukturiert, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert an. Du hast einen hohen Serviceanspruch, kommunizierst gerne mit Menschen und kannst auch komplexe technische Themen verständlich erklären. Du interessierst dich für Automatisierung, KI und digitale Prozesse und hast Freude daran, bestehende Abläufe zu hinterfragen und weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest selbstständig, sorgfältig und verantwortungsbewusst und bringst ein gutes Verständnis für IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz mit. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Besonders freuen wir uns, wenn du außerdem Folgendes mitbringst: Erfahrung mit Apple Business Manager in Verbindung mit Microsoft Intune Praktische Kenntnisse in Power Automate, Make oder vergleichbaren Automatisierungstools Kenntnisse in PowerShell, APIs oder der Anbindung unterschiedlicher Systeme Erfahrung mit KI-Agenten, KI-gestützten Workflows oder MCP-Servern (Model Context Protocol) Weiterführende Kenntnisse in Microsoft Defender und IT-Sicherheitskonzepten Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Kein Problem! Uns ist wichtiger, dass du ein gutes technisches Fundament mitbringst, gerne dazulernst und Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns etwas zu bewegen. Das bieten wir dir Flexible Teilzeit: Wir planen aktuell mit etwa 20 Wochenstunden, sind aber offen für einen höheren Stundenumfang. Gemeinsam finden wir ein Modell, das zu dir und unseren Aufgaben passt. Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum : Du übernimmst eigene IT-Themen, bringst Ideen ein und kannst Verbesserungen direkt umsetzen. Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben: Von Microsoft 365 und Apple bis hin zu Automatisierung und KI – bei uns erwarten dich vielfältige technische Herausforderungen. Ein Team, das zusammenhält : Freu dich auf großartige Kolleg*innen, gegenseitige Unterstützung, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Management, das immer ein offenes Ohr hat. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung: Wir machen dich mit unseren Systemen, Prozessen und dem Team vertraut, damit du gut bei uns ankommen kannst. Flexibles Arbeiten: Teilzeit- und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten sowie eine offene Feedback-, Vertrauens- und Duz-Kultur. Attraktive Benefit s: Deutschland-Ticket oder Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, Snacks und Getränke sowie regelmäßige Teamevents. description: Ingénieur Projet Pré-FEED (H/F) Informations clés Référence : 262403S Démarrage : Janvier 2027 Durée : Mission longue durée Type de contrat : Freelance ou CDIC Zone géographique : Occitanie (81) Langue : Anglais courant indispensable Contexte de la mission Dans le cadre d'un programme de construction d'une nouvelle usine industrielle à l'international, prévu sur la période 2028-2032, nous recherchons un profil expérimenté pour intervenir en phase amont d'analyse des besoins et de pré-FEED (Front-End Engineering Design). La mission consiste à réaliser un audit approfondi de deux usines de production existantes, l'une en France et l'autre en Amérique du Nord, afin d'identifier les bonnes pratiques, les axes d'amélioration et les besoins des différents services. L'objectif est de recueillir et de formaliser l'ensemble des exigences techniques, fonctionnelles et opérationnelles dans un cahier des charges aussi complet que possible, afin de sécuriser les futures phases d'ingénierie, de conception et de construction de la nouvelle usine. Missions Réaliser un audit fonctionnel et opérationnel de deux usines de production existantes, situées en France et en Amérique du Nord. Analyser les installations, les méthodes de fonctionnement et les organisations en place afin d'identifier les bonnes pratiques, les points faibles et les axes d'amélioration. Organiser et animer des groupes de travail avec l'ensemble des services concernés, notamment : Maintenance Exploitation et production Process industriels Traitement de l'air Conduire des entretiens et des réunions de travail, notamment à distance via Teams, afin de faire émerger les besoins, contraintes et attentes de chaque service. Challenger les interlocuteurs pour identifier les besoins explicites et implicites, anticiper les problématiques et garantir l'exhaustivité des exigences. Recueillir, analyser et consolider les retours d'expérience des deux sites existants. Identifier les exigences techniques, fonctionnelles, organisationnelles et opérationnelles à intégrer dans la conception de la future usine. Définir les besoins d'industrialisation et les exigences relatives aux process de production. Élaborer et structurer un cahier des charges (CDC) complet et détaillé, intégrant les besoins de l'ensemble des parties prenantes. Rédiger les User Requirement Specifications (URS) afin de formaliser les exigences utilisateurs. Participer à la phase de pré-FEED et contribuer à la définition des orientations techniques du futur site industriel. Assurer la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des exigences afin de limiter les oublis, les modifications tardives et les risques lors des phases ultérieures du projet. Faciliter les échanges entre les différents métiers et accompagner la convergence des besoins vers des spécifications communes. Expérience dans des environnements industriels de process, idéalement dans les secteurs de la chimie, de la cosmétique, de l'agroalimentaire ou d'industries de transformation similaires. Solide expérience en audit d'installations industrielles existantes, analyse fonctionnelle et identification des besoins opérationnels. Maîtrise de la rédaction de cahiers des charges techniques et des User Requirement Specifications (URS). Bonne compréhension des enjeux industriels liés aux process, à la maintenance, à l'exploitation, à la production et aux utilités, notamment au traitement de l'air. Capacité à analyser des organisations et installations existantes pour en tirer des recommandations applicables à une construction neuve. Excellentes compétences en animation d'ateliers et en coordination de groupes de travail pluridisciplinaires. Charisme, leadership et forte capacité à faire parler les différents interlocuteurs, y compris sur des besoins non formalisés. Capacité à poser les bonnes questions, challenger les pratiques existantes et faire émerger les attentes de chaque métier. Excellentes capacités d'écoute, d'analyse, de synthèse et de formalisation des exigences. Vision globale des projets industriels et capacité à anticiper les impacts des choix réalisés en phase amont sur les étapes de conception et de construction. Autonomie, rigueur, diplomatie et capacité à fédérer des interlocuteurs aux enjeux parfois divergents. Expérience des environnements multiculturels et des projets industriels internationaux. title: Director of MSSP Sales, EMEA
description: At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. The Director, MSSP Sales, EMEA will architect, build, and scale ExtraHop’s dedicated MSSP and MDR business across EMEA. As ExtraHop continues to dominate the Network Detection and Response (NDR) space, this leader will transform how managed service providers leverage the Reveal(x) platform to deliver high-fidelity threat detection and response to their end customers. You will own the entire lifecycle of the MSSP relationship: from strategic partner acquisition and commercial modeling to technical enablement and co-selling execution Key Responsibilities Strategy & Commercial Modeling: Define the Go-To-Market (GTM): Design and execute a comprehensive EMEA strategy specifically targeting top-tier MSSPs and MDR providers. Structure MSSP Frameworks: Collaborate with Finance, Product, and Operations to design scalable, competitive commercial models (e.g., consumption-based pricing, multi-tenant licensing, pay-as-you-grow, and subscription models). Value Proposition: Refine ExtraHop's messaging to clearly articulate how our platform reduces MSSP analyst burnout, lowers mean time to resolution (MTTR), and increases partner margins. Partner Acquisition & Revenue Generation: Pipeline Ownership: Directly hunt and secure predictable, recurring revenue streams by embedding ExtraHop Reveal(x) into the core tech stacks of major MSSPs Co-Sell & Sell-Through: Drive both "sell-to" (the MSSP's own infrastructure) and "sell-through/with" (leveraging the MSSP's sales force to pull ExtraHop into enterprise accounts) revenue streams. Executive Relationships: Build deep, trust-based relationships with C-level executives (CEOs, CISOs, CTOs) within the target MSSP ecosystem. Cross-Functional Leadership & Enablement: Team Building: Act as a player-coach initially, with the mandate to recruit, hire, and lead a high-performing team of MSSP Account Managers and Channel Solutions Architects as the business scales. Enablement Ecosystem: Partner with ExtraHop Technical Marketing and Sales Enablement to build specialized onboarding, technical training, and co-marketing (MDF) programs tailored for MSSPs. Product Feedback Loop: Act as the voice of the MSSP partner internally, providing feedback to Product Management regarding multi-tenancy, API integrations, and reporting capabilities. Required Qualifications ● 10+ Years in Cybersecurity Sales: A proven track record of selling enterprise-grade security software (preferably NDR, EDR, SIEM, or XDR). ● 5+ Years of Dedicated MSSP/MDR Leadership: Direct experience owning, scaling, and structuring deals with major MSSPs (e.g., Optiv, Secureworks, Verizon, Deloitte, Expel). ● Proven "Zero-to-One" Success: Experience building a new route-to-market, division, or partner program from scratch within an established tech company. ● Complex Commercial Structuring: Deep familiarity with usage-based, multi-tenant, and utility pricing models. Preferred Qualifications ● High Technical Acumen: Ability to speak authoritatively with MSSP SOC Directors and CTOs about architecture, APIs, and integration ecosystems. ● Strong Operational Discipline: Ability to accurately forecast revenue based on a partner led managed service sales motion rather than direct to customer sales motion. ● Gravitas & Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to navigate complex, multi-party enterprise deal cycles. ABOUT EXTRAHOP ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments. This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise. Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues. Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
description: About Finom Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform. We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe. Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business. The Role For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day. That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership. How We Build Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others. What You'll Do What You'll Do Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation. Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle. Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details. Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech. Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team. Who You Are Who You Are You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three. Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue. Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build. Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team. T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform. Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague. Your Experience Includes 5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift. Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns. Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better. Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI. Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools. Ability to write unit and UI tests. Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD. Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included. A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code. Nice to Have Nice to Have Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment. Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain). Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS. Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar. Published apps on the App Store you're proud of. An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share. Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI dev

title: Orbital Analyst
description: Orbital Analyst About us Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit. We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked. Our station network is expanding across Europe, South America, Africa and Australia. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space. We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, Innovate UK and the European Innovation Council. Position Overview You’ll be the operationally responsive member of the Astrodynamics team. You’ll take on a wide range of tasks, from producing analysis to demonstrate Foundational’s world leading capabilities, through customer facing discussions with the business development team to supporting customers with operational issues or special requirements. Expect to also be a key point of contact for our ground station teams to help ensure smooth functioning of our tracking network. Key Responsibilities Monitor Foundational’s orbit determination and prediction pipelines, identifying failure cases and areas for improvement Produce white papers, conference papers, and marketing materials demonstrating accuracy provided by SLR data Work closely with potential and existing customers to understand needs, and ensure they get the most from Foundational’s product offering Perform operational support for customers where necessary Support and supervise SLR tracking operations Required Operational experience working with spacecraft tracking data and orbit determination/prediction Ability to communicate with non specialists about astrodynamics, orbit determination, etc Willingness to engage with existing and potential customers to provide support Able to apply rigorous analysis to problems/datasets in astrodynamics Experience with Python, ability to build tooling to conduct analysis Nice to have Prior experience working with Business Development teams/in a sales environment Good overall understanding of the space sector Experience writing proposals What We Offer A high-impact role with real ownership at an early-stage, venture-backed spacetech company EMI share options (UK employees) Cycle to work scheme Enhanced parental leave Work alongside engineers and scientists across optics, lasers, software and astrodynamics Offices in central London with snacks, tea, coffee and regular socials Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Who are we? Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore. How we work Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data. Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer. Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted. What will you do? The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents. The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead. The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real. Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins. Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view. Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks. In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models. Who are you? You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering. In the last 1–2 years you've shipped LLM agents or pipelines that real users depend on, not demos. You have modelling judgement. You've dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real data. You measure before you claim. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one. You care about the user outcome more than the technique. Ideas without a clear customer benefit don't get built here, however interesting. Nice to have: time-to-event modelling, noisy or conflicting data sources, financial or private-company data. No finance background needed. The team You'll join our Data & AI team of six and report to Renan, our AI Lead who's been building production models for >10 years. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, and you shape what runs on it. The stack Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents. Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire Data: PostgreSQL with pgvector Cloud: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks), Docker, GitHub Actions What do we offer? title: Creator Acquisition & Content Manager (m/w/d)
description: Your mission TikTok Shop verändert die Art und Weise, wie Menschen Produkte entdecken und kaufen – und wir gestalten diese Entwicklung aktiv mit. Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Creatorn und Influencern auf und pflegst diese aktiv. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team eine lebendige und engagierte Creator Community rund um GENUINE und unsere Partnermarken. Du organisierst Creator Meetups, Networking-Events, Content Days und weitere Community-Aktivitäten. Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Creator und unterstützt sie bei ihrer Weiterentwicklung. Du recherchierst und analysierst erfolgreiche TikTok-Videos und identifizierst die Faktoren, die sie besonders erfolgreich machen. Du erkennst virale Hooks, Storytelling-Techniken und kreative Ansätze, die Reichweite, Engagement und Conversions steigern. Du entwickelst aus Trends und Performance-Daten kreative Content-Ideen, Konzepte und überzeugende Videoskripte. Du konzipierst innovative Content-Formate, die auf unterschiedliche Marken, Produkte und Zielgruppen zugeschnitten sind. Content Creation & Videoproduktion Du planst, organisierst und koordinierst Videodrehs mit unseren TikTok Creatorn. Du produzierst gemeinsam mit Creatorn authentischen, unterhaltsamen und verkaufsstarken TikTok-Content. Du schreibst kreative Skripte, entwickelst spannende Storylines und überzeugende Hooks. Du begleitest Creator durch den gesamten Produktionsprozess – von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Video. Du experimentierst mit unterschiedlichen Videoformaten, Storytelling-Techniken und kreativen Ansätzen. Du stellst sicher, dass der produzierte Content sowohl zu unseren Markenpartnern als auch zur TikTok-Plattform passt. Performance Analyse & Optimierung Du analysierst die Performance unserer Videos anhand relevanter KPIs wie Views, Engagement, Conversion Rate und GMV. Du erkennst erfolgreiche Content-Muster und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Du gibst unseren Creatorn konstruktives Feedback und hilfst ihnen dabei, ihre Inhalte kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Growth-, Shop-Management- und Creator-Management-Teams zusammen, um die Performance unserer Inhalte zu maximieren. Your profile Ausgeprägte TikTok-Affinität: Du bist auf TikTok zu Hause, verfolgst aktiv Trends und verstehst die Plattform, ihre Kultur, Algorithmen und Content-Formate. Du hast ein natürliches Gespür dafür, welche Videos Aufmerksamkeit erzeugen und viral gehen können. Du bist ein echter TikTok Native: Du konsumierst Content nicht einfach nur, sondern verstehst, warum bestimmte Videos funktionieren, erkennst neue Trends frühzeitig und kannst Inspirationen in kreative Ideen verwandeln. Kreativität: Du liebst es, neue Content-Ideen zu entwickeln, Skripte zu schreiben und innovative Videoformate auszuprobieren. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist offen, kontaktfreudig und hast Spaß daran, neue Menschen kennenzulernen und langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen. Leidenschaft für die Creator Economy: Du verstehst die Creator-Szene und erkennst schnell, welche Talente Potenzial haben. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst gerne selbst mit an, organisierst Drehs und setzt kreative Ideen gemeinsam mit Creatorn in die Praxis um. Analytisches Denken: Du hast Spaß daran, Video-Performance zu analysieren und aus Daten neue kreative Ansätze abzuleiten. Eigeninitiative & Organisation: Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl. Erste Erfahrungen im Influencer Marketing, Creator Management, Social Media oder in der Content-Produktion sind von Vorteil. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Why us? Das bieten wir dir Die Möglichkeit, eine der am schnellsten wachsenden TikTok Creator Communities Deutschlands aktiv mitzugestalten. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit spannenden Marken, kreativen Talenten und erfahrenen E-Commerce-Experten. Ein kreatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem deine Ideen schnell Realität werden können. Viel Eigenverantwortung und die Freiheit, neue Content-Formate auszuprobieren. Ein junges, ambitioniertes und internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien. Ein modernes Office mit Möglichkeiten zur Content-Produktion mitten in Köln. Attraktive Benefits wie Urban Sports Club und einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket. Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in der schnell wachsenden Welt des Social Commerce. Bereit, die Zukunft des Social Commerce mitzugestalten? Bei GENUINE betreuen wir nicht einfach nur Creator – wir bauen eine Community auf, die die Zukunft des Social Commerce aktiv mitgestaltet. Wenn TikTok deine Welt ist, Kreativität zu deinen Stärken gehört und du gerne mit Menschen zusammenarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen! You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential. Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge? As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job. Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices. What You'll Work On You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include: Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist. What Success Looks Like Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable. Who We're Looking For We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious. Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning No active backlogs Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++ Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before. Our Culture More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning. At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it. Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Stage Customer Success Manager (H/F)
description: GPTW France accompagne les entreprises à transformer l’expérience de leurs collaborateurs et développer une culture de confiance, en s’appuyant sur trois leviers clés : analyse approfondie de la donnée collectée, des benchmarks pertinents et l’activation de la marque employeur. Vos missions Missions principales Cadrage client & pilotage de projet Participer au cadrage des projets d’enquête avec les clients sur Emprising : périmètre, planning, modalités de diffusion, contraintes techniques. Echanger régulièrement avec les équipes projet chez nos clients (RH, Communication et DSI) tout au long du projet. Data, reporting & livrables Traiter les données sur notre outil de Web Reporting ROBIN. Identifier les signaux faibles de satisfaction ou d’usage et les remonter à l’AM/KAM en charge du compte. Tu aimes la gestion de projet et le contact client, et tu sais mener plusieurs projets en parallèle avec rigueur et sens des priorités. Tu es à l’aise avec les données chiffrées et leur mise en forme. Tu connais bien le Pack Office, en particulier Excel et PowerPoint, et tu aimes découvrir de nouveaux logiciels ou outils. Tu es à l’aise avec l’apprentissage de nouveaux outils, notamment les outils d’IA. Tu es intéressé(e) par les sujets de ressources humaines : qualité de vie au travail, culture d’entreprise, RSE, performance des organisations. Tu aimes travailler en équipe. La maîtrise de l’anglais niveau professionnel est fortement recommandée, certains comptes étant gérés à l’échelle internationale. Nous nous engageons à mener un recrutement inclusif et ouvert à tous les profils. Nous considérons la diversité comme une chance pour notre organisation et nous étudions, à compétences égales, toutes les candidatures. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: PLC Software Engineer - The Netherlands
description: Ready to build the software behind real-world renewable energy installations? At Bright Renewables, your PLC software doesn’t stay behind a desk. You’ll see it come to life in complex industrial installations for renewable gas and CO₂ technologies. As a PLC Software Engineer , you’ll be involved in the complete automation lifecycle - from software design and programming to testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to technical decisions, help shape our automation standards, and work alongside experienced colleagues as part of an international software engineering team of around 10 engineers. Together, you’ll collaborate across the Netherlands, Latvia, and Poland to develop and deliver reliable, innovative automation solutions. Why this role? You’ll get the opportunity to: Own your solutions - contribute to software solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from design and programming to testing and commissioning; Work on real installations - solve automation challenges in complex renewable energy plants; Have technical influence - contribute to software standards, templates, concepts, and ways of working, within a team that values collaboration and embraces innovative ideas from everyone; Keep developing - work alongside experienced Electrical and Software Engineers and continue building your technical expertise; Work internationally - collaborate with colleagues and project teams in the Netherlands, Poland, Latvia and beyond, including regular international travel to visit our offices and project sites; Choose what works for you - work 32 or 40 hours per week, with flexible starting times and opportunities to work from home; Make an impact - use your automation expertise in technologies that contribute directly to the energy transition. What will you do? As a PLC Software Engineer, you design, develop, test, and commission PLC and SCADA control systems for technologies such as gas upgrading and CO₂ liquefaction. You report directly to the Manager E&I and Software and work closely with Electrical Engineers, Process Engineers and fellow Software Engineers . Depending on your experience, you’ll also have the opportunity to take more technical ownership, contribute to software concepts and standards, and support colleagues with complex automation challenges. Your responsibilities include: Designing, programming, testing, and commissioning PLC and SCADA systems ; Developing control software for gas upgrading, CO₂ liquefaction, and other renewable energy technologies; Taking ownership of your software from engineering through commissioning; Testing and troubleshooting software during commissioning and operation; Analyzing and resolving software and control-related issues in existing installations; Implementing software updates and optimizations; Supporting Service Engineers with more complex automation and software questions; Contributing to software standards, templates, and automation concepts; Working closely with Electrical Engineers, Software Engineers, and other technical disciplines; Sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues within the engineering team. What do you bring? We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges and wants to take responsibility for their own engineering work. Ideally, you have: A completed technical education in automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field; Several years of experience in PLC/SCADA engineering within an industrial environment; Hands-on experience in PLC programming, ideally with Siemens S7 and TIA Portal, combined with knowledge of WinCC SCADA, industrial communication networks, and remote access solutions. Experience with commissioning and troubleshooting industrial installations; A good understanding of automation architectures and industrial control systems; Good command of English, both spoken and written; Knowledge of OT security is a plus. What’s in it for you? We want to give you the technical freedom and working environment to do your best engineering work. You can expect: A competitive salary based on your experience and technical background; The option to work 32 or 40 hours per week; Flexible starting times between 7:00 and 9:00 a.m. ; Ample opportunities to work from home, including a one-time €250 allowance to set up your home office; An attractive annual profit-sharing scheme for employees with at least 12 months of service; An excellent pension scheme; 8% annual holiday allowance; A commuting allowance of €0.23 per kilometer, in accordance with our employment conditions; A high level of autonomy and responsibility; Plenty of opportunities for technical and professional development; An international engineering environment with both experienced professionals and engineers earlier in their careers; The opportunity to work with renewable energy technologies and contribute directly to the energy transition; A bike lease program and rewards for cycling to work; A modern, sustainably built working environment in Hengelo. About Bright Renewables Bright Renewables develops and delivers technologies for renewable gas and CO₂ capture, providing solutions from engineering and realization through to service and maintenance. Our installations convert biogas into renewable natural gas and capture, purify, and liquefy CO₂ for industrial reuse. We are part of HoSt Group , a family-owned Dutch company operating internationally in renewable energy technology. For you, that means working on international projects with the opportunities of a global organization, while keeping the short communication lines, technical freedom, and personal approach of a family-owned company. Interested? We’d like to get to know you. Apply by submitting your CV and motivation through the application button. Within 14 days, we’ll let you know whether we’d like to invite you for an interview. Would you first like to know more about the technology, team, or day-to-day work? Contact Wybren Broersma, Manager E&I and Software, or Natalia Wisniewska, Corporate Recruiter, at +31 88 460 90 80. Build software. See it running. Make an impact on renewable energy. title: Accounting Expert: AI Model Evaluation
description: About Huzzle Labs Huzzle Labs partners with frontier AI labs to evaluate and improve frontier models through deep human expertise. Contributors directly assess advanced AI systems in their specialist fields, receive competitive compensation, and help define the standards used to measure model performance. About the Role Huzzle Labs is seeking experienced accountants to write realistic accounting tasks that test how well frontier AI systems handle accounting work. You will create prompts that are difficult enough for a frontier model to fail, then write a scoring rubric for each task so reviewers can assess the output consistently. A rubric is a list of objective, checkable criteria that a reviewer marks pass or fail. Your judgement helps define the standards used to measure model performance. This is an expert judgement role focused on realistic task design, careful review of model output and precise, consistent documentation. Training is provided. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required. Responsibilities Write realistic accounting tasks: Create requests of the kind a client, controller or business owner would send, covering month-end close, bank and credit card reconciliations, AR/AP ageing, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax, job costing and the clean-up of incomplete or inconsistent books. Build from real material: Review a deal room containing hundreds of files, select the relevant documents and use them to develop prompts and rubrics for tasks a frontier model struggles to complete correctly. Require usable deliverables: Each request should call for a working output, usually a spreadsheet, a journal entry schedule or a short memo. Test against a frontier model: Run each request and review the output with the care you would apply when signing off accounting work. Where the model succeeds, increase the difficulty until a genuine gap appears. Write scoring rubrics: Define objective criteria that another reviewer can apply without repeating your work, for example, “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue.” Apply guidelines consistently: Follow the task and rubric guidelines, flag ambiguous cases and help refine the criteria. Requirements At least 5 years in accounting, bookkeeping or finance operations. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required. Hands-on knowledge of month-end close, reconciliations, AR/AP, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax and job costing. Excellent written English and precision with numbers. Careful and detail-oriented: accurate figures and objective, checkable criteria. Available 20 to 40 hours per week for an initial one-week trial, with potential extension. Example Assignment For a client deal room covering a small business with incomplete and inconsistent books, you would: Review the files and select the relevant documents, such as bank statements, ledgers, invoices and ageing reports. Write a prompt as the business owner or controller would, asking for a reconciliation and the adjusting entries needed to close the month. Run the prompt against a frontier AI model and check the spreadsheet or journal entry schedule line by line. If the model completes the task correctly, increase the difficulty, for example, by adding a customer deposit, a timing difference or a sales tax complication, until it fails. Write the rubric, such as “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue,” so another reviewer can grade any answer without repeating the work. Confidentiality An NDA must be signed before the engagement begins. Benefits Compensation: $60 - $90 USD / hour Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
