title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description: Why Kimchi? Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves. Kimchi Inference One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship. Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion. About the role Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token. Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data. The problem: the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next. Stack: Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI. Requirements You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks. Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts. You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU. You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios. Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes. You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move. You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact. A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you. Nice to haves You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts. Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems. You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money. Responsibilities Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it. Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or network) and fix it, not the one you assumed. Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it. Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business taking an hour to reach serving. Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks. Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck on storage or interconnect. Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible experiments. What’s in it for you? title: Medior/senior R&D Engineer Human Machine Teaming
description: Wil jij de samenwerking tussen intelligente systemen en de gebruiker verkennen, verbeteren én vanuit die kennis innovatieve toepassingen ontwikkelen? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Als R&D Engineer Human Machine Teaming (HMT) ben je betrokken in de hele keten van onderzoek naar hoe intelligente en autonome systemen de mens kunnen ondersteunen in complexe taakomgevingen. Als ervaren kracht verwachten wij dat je je comfortabel voelt in verschillende rollen en je moeiteloos beweegt tussen projectleiding, proposal management en onderzoek. Dit betekent dat je niet alleen het initiatief neemt tot nieuwe projecten maar ook de klantvraag uitwerkt en je inhoudelijk meewerkt aan projecten waarin je de voortgang bewaakt en proactief communiceert richting de opdrachtgever! Je ontwerpt de interactie tussen gebruiker en geavanceerde systemen, ontwikkelt proof-of-concepts en demonstrators en/of beproeft wat wel en niet werkt in experimenten in onze simulatie- en XR-omgevingen. Wat ga je doen? Als R&D Engineer Human Machine Teamings bij NLR verken je voor uiteenlopende projecten innovatieve mens – techniek samenwerkingsconcepten. Soms zijn dit interne kennisontwikkelingsprojecten of Europese onderzoekscalls, ook werk je voor civiele klanten en defensie. Je werkt daarbij samen met collega’s met uiteenlopende expertises, zoals Human Factors specialisten, UX-designers, Software ontwikkelaars, AI-experts en Onderwijsdeskundigen. Hierbij maak je gebruik van onze AR/VR, spatial computing en human-in-the-loop simulatieomgevingen. Een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden: Je bent bekend met de (on)mogelijkheden van de nieuwste AI-technologie, vergaard nieuwe kennis hierover, en bedenkt hoe dit ingezet kan worden om mensen te ondersteunen in hun dagelijks werk. Je bekijkt vanuit een technologisch oogpunt de interactie tussen mens en intelligente systemen. Hoe kan je een AI of automatisering zo ontwerpen dat het goed samenwerkt met de menselijke operator? Jij bedenkt en ontwerpt met je collega’s nieuwe samenwerkingsconcepten voor verschillende levels van autonomie en werkt deze uit in een testomgeving. Je begeleidt het (co-)ontwerpproces en softwareontwikkeling en evalueert het uiteindelijke resultaat in een operationele omgeving of gecontroleerd experiment. Uiteindelijk publiceer je de resultaten wanneer mogelijk in een wetenschappelijk tijdschrift. Je bedenkt en leidt onderzoeksprojecten in opdracht van (externe) stakeholders of voor interne kennisontwikkelingsprojecten. Wat breng je mee? Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten! Daarnaast: Beschik je over aantoonbaar WO werk- en denkniveau. Je hebt bijvoorbeeld een afgeronde opleiding of PhD in Human-Computer Interaction, Design for Interaction, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare studie waarin AI en/of Mens Machine Interactie een belangrijke rol speelt; Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 3 jaar kennis en ervaring op het gebied van AI of HIS en/of in relevante onderzoeksprojecten; Heb je ervaring met het leiden van ontwerp- of onderzoeksprojecten gericht op geavanceerde, autonome en/of intelligente systemen in complexe taakomgevingen; Heb je kennis van en ervaring met het toepassen van AI-technieken en software ontwikkeling, zoals praktische ervaring met Python, NLP / LLM, en ML-frameworks. Of hebt ervaring met ontwikkeling en implementatie van UI/UX design voor informatie intensieve systemen en/of complexe werkomgevingen; Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties; Kun jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken. Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast dit alles bieden wij jou: De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken; 45 verlofdagen (bij fulltime dienstverband); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer. Een zorgtoelage via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken op dit moment rond de 90 deskundigen op het gebied van selectie, training, simulatie, informatica, luchtvaart en psychologie. De afdeling is groeiende, multi-disciplinair en jong qua leeftijdsopbouw en beschikt over onderzoeksmiddelen zoals verschillende vliegsimulatoren, een battlelab en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR-innovaties. Binnen deze afdeling werk het HMI-T team nauw samen met collega’s binnen de rest van Training & Simulatie én met collega’s van andere afdelingen binnen NLR. Ook wordt bij de stakeholders op locatie gewerkt. Een plezierige werkomgeving vinden we essentieel. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. title: Teamleider ICT & Security (m/v/x)
description: DNW zoekt een teamleider die ICT en security samenbrengt: iemand die zorgt dat onze medewerkers goed kunnen werken, onze systemen betrouwbaar beschikbaar zijn en onze informatie veilig blijft. Wat ga je doen? Je geeft leiding aan het team ICT & Security en bent verantwoordelijk voor de integrale aansturing van ICT en het organisatie brede security domein (Duitsland en Nederland). Je zorgt voor een samenhangende aanpak van fysieke beveiliging, informatiebeveiliging en IT-/cybersecurity in lijn met ISO 27001, wet- en regelgeving en de organisatiedoelstellingen. Op locaties Marknesse en Amsterdam levert je team lokale ICT ondersteuning. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. You will triage and prioritise incoming requests, clearly articulating client needs, priorities and timelines to the right Kraken teams to support effective delivery and the ongoing development of the platform. You will work closely with product managers and developers to translate client needs into clear priorities and support the delivery of product features. You will challenge clients to think differently about technology development, championing Kraken's iterative approach and shared platform over bespoke solutions. Resilience and empathy, staying positive and persistent through challenges while understanding the human impact of transformation and supporting clients through change with patience and sensitivity. We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open-minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever-changing environment. ⭐ Bonus points: Consulting experience. description: tl;dr After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the AI foundation for the construction industry 6 of Europe's 20 largest construction companies already rely on Kuro, with leading construction enterprises representing over €40bn in combined annual construction volume using the platform every day Construction has some of the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling. Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction. After one year on the market, leading construction enterprises with a combined annual construction volume of >€40 billion use Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions. Backed by an €10 million seed round, we already process more than 1 million pages every month and expect that volume to grow 10x over the next six months. We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind. Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin What You'll Do Set the technical direction Own the architecture decisions for the platform, from document ingestion to the chat UI Write and review RFCs. Turn a vague customer request (“show me where the bid deviates from the BoQ”) into a scoped plan with the risks named. Raise the bar for the team Mentor engineers: Review their designs and their code. Define the engineering standards. Find what slows the team down, in tooling or in the CI/CD pipeline, and fix it. Interview and hire engineers. You have no direct reports. You change decisions in product and in other teams with a written argument. Build and own end-to-end (AI) features Design and implement new features to solve a specific user problem, such as document versioning or our agentic Chat. From concept to DB schema, to optimizing LLMs, to UI. Own the full development lifecycle of customer-facing features. Manage evaluations and scoring, and perform error analysis on new and shipped AI features. Build the platform that abstracts workflow building Contribute to the workflow harness, decision-trace standard, and eval tooling so a new use case ships in ~1 month Build reusable human review & approval surfaces where trust in AI output is earned Work on the construction ontology & project graph Help model and evolve canonical entities of our customers Contribute to entity resolution across sources: recognizing the same requirement, position, or price across BoQs, contracts, drawings, and bids Build features so answers are evidence-linked and auditable, and decisions flow back into the graph Contribute to scalable data pipelines & integrations Extend our multi-modal ingestion of unstructured documents - PDFs, scans, drawings, and 3D models - orchestrated and cost-efficient at scale Build read/write integrations with customer systems (document management, ERP/AVA), so workflows complete work end-to-end Projects you would be involved in Current & Past projects Project & document versioning guaranteeing data lineage in construction projects German tokenizer for construction-specific search Document pipeline ingesting 10,000s of PDFs per day Native BIM/DWG file support: ingesting and processing 3D models Design the ontology v1 + graph schema: core construction entities, evidence links, and per-customer extension model Build out our workflow harness to run agentic workflows for customers Current Tech Stack It is still day 0 for Kuro. Therefore, we are highly pragmatic with our tool choices. We believe in keeping it simple and moving quickly. You significantly help shape our tech stack decisions. Web-App: Typescript Database / Vector DB and File Storage: AWS RDS / Trubopuffer / AWS S3 Backend: Fastify API + Prisma ORM Workflow Orchestrator: Prefect (Python) Hosting: AWS Elastic Beanstalk AI: Azure / OpenAI, Gemini, Cohere, AWS Obsv., Eval. & Tracking: Langfuse, Datadog Your profile This is the perfect role for an experienced engineer who wants to join an early stage company that builds a high impact applied AI product Bring 6+ years of experience as a Staff (full-stack) software engineer or Technical Lead, in a fast-paced environment Have proven experience delivering production-grade applied AI features to customers Take full ownership of solving customer problems by designing and implementing AI features Thrive in a small, accountable team with a high degree of ownership and a drive to make an impact Communicate fluently in both spoken and written English Enjoy working onsite with the team at our office in Factory Berlin Mitte every day Bonus Points You’ve started a company before or worked at a very early stage startup You built side projects in the past - we’re excited to hear about these! You’ll own customer-facing features end to end while building the foundations beneath them, from ingestion pipelines and workflow infrastructure to our construction ontology and project graph. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who has: 4–6+ years in influencer or creator marketing Campaign execution experience. You have actually run creative marketing activations, not just managed client relationships from a distance. Enterprise account servicing at scale. Multi-stakeholder, high-volume, complex. You have managed accounts with this many moving parts before. Exceptional organisation. The volume of comms, briefs, regions, and stakeholders on this account is unusually high. Getting lost is easy. You don't get lost. Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset. You take ownership of learning, build internal relationships proactively, and don't wait to be told what to do. Strong hands-on campaign experience, with real fluency in TikTok. AI fluency, applied. Our platform is AI-powered and you'll be expected to get up to speed fast and use it daily for client summaries, performance narratives, and campaign analysis. We're looking for people already comfortable using AI tools in their workflow, so the learning curve is the platform, not the concept. Comfortable working across project management tools (Asana, Airtable, Slack) and reporting dashboards. CPG or multi-category consumer brand experience is a plus. You should be commercially sharp, operationally reliable, and able to speak confidently about the accounts you've managed. Traits That Matter Proactive. Organised. Adaptable. Self-starting. Comfortable with ambiguity. You don't wait for problems to land. You see them coming and act. You don't need rigid processes or hand-holding. Tools, product, and ways of working evolve constantly here, and you thrive on that. You're willing to say "I don't know" and go find out. You take feedback well. You build trust fast. What Success Looks Like What Success Looks Like By Month 1: You have full context on all active sub-brands, briefs, and stakeholders. You've built a strong working relationship with the Campaign Director and the internal pod. The client knows your name and trusts you to run things. By Month 3: Delivery is running smoothly across all regions. You own reporting and client comms without oversight. Post-campaign analysis is sharp and drives clear recommendations. Internal teams come to you, not around you. By Month 6: The account is in better shape than when you arrived. Stakeholder satisfaction is high. Nothing has been dropped. Leadership trusts your judgement completely. Benefits 🏢 Hybrid working. 3 days per week in-office, 4 days during your first 2 weeks of onboarding. 🌴 Annual Time Off: 25 days PTO (pro-rated) + bank holidays (pro-rated), 4 company-wide days off (Kyra Days), 3 wellness days, and paid sick leave each year 📚 Growth: Annual Learning & Development budget to invest in your skills. 💰 Rewards: Annual bonus scheme to recognise great work AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience. 💟 Support If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. title: CRO Manager e-commerce (H/F)
description: Présentation Leads Power est expert en génération de leads. Nous déployons de plus en plus fort un pôle e-commerce spécialisé, avec une exigence : la performance ne s'arrête pas à la plateforme publicitaire, elle se joue aussi sur le site. Tu rejoins ce pôle pour optimiser la conversion et le panier moyen d'un portefeuille de boutiques e-commerce. Missions Analyser les parcours d'achat (données chiffrées, enregistrements de sessions, tests utilisateurs) pour repérer ce qui fait perdre des ventes. Construire et tenir une feuille de route de tests priorisés, boutique par boutique. Piloter les tests A/B de l'hypothèse à la mise en ligne : conception, suivi, analyse, décision. Travailler avec le media buyer, le créa strat et le développement pour livrer vite les variantes gagnantes. Faire monter la conversion et le panier moyen (upsell, bundles, recommandations produit). Documenter chaque test dans nos outils internes et partager les apprentissages à l'équipe. Suivre l'évolution de chaque boutique sur un tableau de bord hebdomadaire. Profil recherché Tu connais déjà le CRO : tu as mené des tests A/B de bout en bout. À l'aise avec GA4 et un outil d'A/B testing (Kameleoon, AB Tasty, VWO ou équivalent). Une bonne culture statistique : tu sais dire quand un test est fiable et quand il ne l'est pas. Tu écris des hypothèses claires et tu présentes tes résultats simplement. Avantages Une évolution selon tes résultats. Une rémunération attractive, qui suit tes résultats. Un portefeuille de boutiques à la hauteur de ton niveau. title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description: Heel werkend Nederland op de fiets! Dat is de krachtige missie van Lease a Bike, waar we ons dagelijks vol passie voor inzetten. Om onze marktleidende positie verder uit te bouwen en nog meer impact te maken, zijn wij op zoek naar een commercieel gedreven Senior Customer Success Manager. In deze rol krijg jij de verantwoordelijkheid over een portfolio van middelgrote en grote accounts. Je helpt nieuwe klanten succesvol te onboarden en bouwt aan langetermijnrelaties. Een hoge klanttevredenheid en zo veel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen zijn hierbij jouw belangrijkste doelen. Dit doe je natuurlijk niet alleen: je werkt nauw samen in een gedreven team van 6 collega’s. Jouw rol als Customer Success Manager Als Customer Success Manager ben jij de centrale spil tussen jouw klanten en onze interne organisatie. Je schakelt dagelijks met werkgevers en bent intern de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Product & Innovation, Marketing en Customer Support. In jouw portefeuille richt jij je specifiek op bedrijven met 500+ medewerkers. Zodra Sales de samenwerkingsovereenkomst heeft getekend, neem jij het stokje over. Je leidt de implementatie en begeleidt de klant gedurende de gehele levenscyclus. Je adviseert werkgevers bij cruciale beleidskeuzes, helpt hen het platform optimaal in te richten en ontwikkelt gerichte activatiecampagnes. Zo zorg je ervoor dat de fietsregeling ook op de lange termijn top-of-mind blijft en de betrokkenheid van werknemers continu hoog is, met als ultiem doel: zoveel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen! Daarnaast ben je analytisch ijzersterk. Je gebruikt data om jouw klantsegment grondig te analyseren, ontdekt waar kansen liggen en weet creatieve ideeën om te zetten in concrete acties en resultaat. Wat vragen we van jou? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding; Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in Customer Success of Accountmanagement; Aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden van implementatietrajecten, relatiebeheer en het schrijven van accountplannen; Commercieel ingesteld en communicatief ijzersterk: je doorgrondt klantbehoeften snel en vertaalt deze naar effectieve actieplannen; Een hoge mate van zelfstandigheid en het vermogen om projecten met diverse stakeholders of complexe vraagstukken te leiden; Een sterk probleemoplossend en analytisch vermogen met focus op het uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties; Je kunt goed plannen, bewaart het overzicht en gaat gestructureerd te werk; Een flexibele en hands-on mentaliteit die past bij een snelgroeiende marktleider; Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en schrift; Wat bieden wij? Naast een uitdagende rol met veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en een grote impact op de verdere groei van Lease a Bike bieden wij nog veel meer: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 3.950,- en € 4.450. 8% vakantiegeld, een bonusregeling van 10% én een jaarlijkse winstuitkering; Een jaarlijkse toekenning van 20 wettelijke verlofdagen, 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen en 6 ATV-dagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband; Een gloednieuwe leasefiets naar keuze (Pon-merk) met een maandelijkse werkgeversbijdrage; Een reiskostenvergoeding of Shuttel-kaart voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor reist; Focus op ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je continu te blijven ontwikkelen via onder andere onze Winter- en Summerlabstrainingen; Een gezonde lunch op kantoor in Amersfoort tegen een kleine bijdrage; Een thuiswerkplek door ons gefaciliteerd met de mogelijkheid voor een netto thuiswerkvergoeding voor als je af en toe thuis wil werken; Een collectieve Zorgverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis met een werkgeversbijdrage; Én, last but not least, een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling bij het Pon Pensioenfonds van 30% waarbij Lease a Bike 20% bijdraagt. Over de organisatie Lease a Bike is ontstaan vanuit liefde voor mensen en fietsen. Voor ons is fietsen niet zomaar een manier van vervoer. Voor ons is fietsen een ‘way of life’. Fietsen is goed voor je gezondheid. Goed voor je portemonnee. Goed voor de wereld. Anderen stimuleren om de fiets te pakken, daar gaan wij voor! Wil jij een bijdrage leveren aan een duurzamere wereld, waarbij vitaliteit en fun hand in hand gaan? Join the ride en draag bij aan de verwezenlijking van onze missie. Als scale-up is Lease a Bike onderdeel van mobiliteitsprovider Bike Mobility Services Group (Pon)! Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation. title: AI Engineer
description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together. You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date. You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence. You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law. You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter. You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years. You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses. You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough. You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs. You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful. Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck. A good base salary and a standard working week of 36 hours. An end-of-year bonus of 4% of your gross annual salary and variable profit sharing of up to 6% of your gross annual salary. 23 holidays and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday allowance and 4% you can spend freely, for example on extra days off. A good pension scheme through PGB, including additional partner insurance. A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometre or a public transport allowance, plus an attractive bike scheme. For employees who live less than 10 km or more than 60 km away, we have a tailored arrangement. Hybrid working: two days a week at the office in The Hague, on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Room to grow. In your field, in your role, in the organisation. WANT TO KNOW MORE? We'd love to tell you everything about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within 2 working days. Any questions first? Text or call Nadine at 0628556265. A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent Recruiting (Fitness Trainer) (m/w/d)
description: Über LIFTED Mit LIFTED bauen wir die neue Go-to-Marke für Krafttraining auf. In einer Welt voller Longevity Quick Fixes und exklusiver Fitness-Trends konzentrieren wir uns auf einen der wichtigsten Faktoren für ein langes und gesundes Leben: Krafttraining. Unsere Studios machen Krafttraining einfach, effektiv und messbar – für Menschen, die stärker werden wollen, sich in klassischen Fitnessstudios aber nicht zuhause fühlen. Der Trainingsfortschritt wird digital erfasst, während unsere Trainer jedes Mitglied individuell unterstützen und für ein motivierendes Trainingserlebnis sorgen. Hinter LIFTED steht ein erfahrenes Founding Team mit tiefem Know-how in der Fitnessbranche & dem Aufbau von Offline Operations. Gemeinsam haben wir BEAT81 von Grund auf aufgebaut und auf 35 Standorte skaliert. Jetzt entwickeln wir Krafttraining mit LIFTED neu – und bauen die nächste große Fitnessmarke auf. In den vergangenen 18 Monaten haben wir 6 Studios in Berlin eröffnet. Bis Ende 2026 werden wir neun Standorte betreiben. Ab 2027 planen wir, jährlich mehr als 12 neue Studios in deutschen Großstädten zu eröffnen. Um dieses Konzept weiter auszubauen, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Recruiting (Fitness Trainer) (m/w/d). Über die Rolle Unsere TrainerInnen sind das Herz von LIFTED. Sie bringen unseren KundInnnen die Grundlagen des Krafttrainings bei, helfen ihnen dabei Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und bieten ein einzigartiges Trainingserlebnis. Und genau die Menschen, die das möglich machen, suchen wir. Als Werkstudent im Trainer Recruiting spielst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Wachstum von LIFTED. Du findest talentierte TrainerInnen, begeisterst sie für uns und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Tryout im Studio. Mit jedem neuen Studio wächst unser Team – und du gestaltest aktiv mit, wer Teil davon wird. Aufgaben Active Sourcing Du findest passende Trainer:innen in ganz Deutschland über Instagram, LinkedIn und andere Kanäle , sprichst sie direkt an und machst sie neugierig auf LIFTED. Screening Du sichtest eingehende Bewerbungen, schätzt ein, wer zu uns passt , und hältst den Überblick über alle Kandidat:innen im Prozess. Erstgespräche Du führst die ersten Interviews , lernst die Kandidat:innen kennen und stellst LIFTED vor. Tryouts organisieren Bevor wir TrainerInnen einstellen, laden wir sie zu einem Tryout ins Studio ein. So lernen wir sie kennen und sehen sie in Action. Du planst diese Tryouts und koordinierst die Termine mit Kandidat:innen und Team. Prozesse mitgestalten Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir unser Recruiting weiterentwickeln können , z.B. durch sauberes Tracking. Dein Profil Du lebst in Berlin und hast Freude daran, Talente für unsere Vision zu begeistern. Folgende Voraussetzungen bringst du mit: Studium: Du bist eingeschrieben, idealerweise in BWL, Psychologie, Sportwissenschaften oder Ähnlichem. Kommunikation: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und fühlst dich auch in Gesprächen mit Fremden wohl. Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mind. C1-Niveau). Menschenkenntnis: Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wer ins Team passt. Organisation: Du behältst auch bei vielen Kandidat:innen gleichzeitig den Überblick. Eigeninitiative: Du packst an und erledigst Dinge, ohne dass jemand nachfragen muss. Fitness-Affinität: Du hast Spaß an Sport – Erfahrung im Krafttraining ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Benefits Early Stage: Du bist früh dabei und gestaltest den Aufbau von LIFTED aktiv mit – eng mit einem Gründerteam, das bereits ein erfolgreiches Fitness-Unternehmen skaliert hat. Echte Verantwortung: Du übernimmst schnell eigene Aufgaben und siehst direkt, was du bewegst – jede:r Trainer, den/die du findest, steht bald in unseren Studios. Learn & Grow: Du lernst Recruiting von Grund auf und bekommst Einblick in den Aufbau eines Startups mit Offline-Produkt. Flexibilität: Deine Arbeitszeiten stimmen wir mit deinem Studium ab. Berlin HQ: Ein schöner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen des Prenzlauer Bergs (Senefelder Platz). Becoming Stronger: Eine kostenlose, unbegrenzte Mitgliedschaft für alle LIFTED Studios. Team Spirit: Regelmäßige Teamevents wie Padel, BBQs, Trainer Partys und mehr. Du willst lernen, wie man ein Team für ein schnell wachsendes Startup aufbaut? Dann ist das deine Chance: Wir sind ein hoch motiviertes Team mit einem schnell wachsenden, profitablen Geschäftsmodell und einer Mission mit echtem Purpose – Krafttraining für alle zugänglich zu machen. Wir schätzen deine Zeit genauso wie dein Talent . Deshalb kannst du auf ein klassisches Anschreiben verzichten. Schick uns einfach deinen CV und eine kurze Notiz (3–5 Sätze) , in der du dein relevantestes Achievement beschreibst. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer
description: Who We Are Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap. We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team. What You'll Do Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer. Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour. Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment. Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers. Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements. What You Bring Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures. Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain. Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing. Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it. Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike. Why Limatica Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead. Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers. Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options. Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us. Ready to find the signal in the noise? Let's build the future of battery diagnostics together. ⚡ Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
description: Your Role As Senior Product Manager – Private Wealth (f/m/d) you build the product for LIQID's most demanding clients: entrepreneurs, families and executives whose relationship with us runs through a personal Relationship Manager. You design for two users at once – the client and the RM – and your mandate is twofold: make our Relationship Managers radically more effective, and design the end-to-end hybrid service, sales and relationship model for our most complex offerings. Our private clients hold portfolios that include private equity funds from KKR, EQT, CVC and Permira and venture stakes in companies like SpaceX, OpenAI, Stripe and Anduril. You make sure that advising on, investing in and living with these portfolios feels like the best of private banking – with the speed and clarity of a digital product. What you'll do End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the private client journey from introduction and first advisory meeting through onboarding, investment and long-term servicing to the next allocation. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree – net new money, share of wallet, time from advisory to investment, private markets adoption, retention, RM book capacity and cost-to-serve – and develop it further where you see sharper signals. RM Enablement & Advisory Tooling: Treat Relationship Managers as users, not stakeholders. You build the tools that give them more time for advice and less for administration: a client 360 view, meeting preparation and follow-up, next-best-action signals, pipeline visibility and AI copilots that draft, summarize and document – within the requirements of MiFID II on suitability, cost transparency and record-keeping. Hybrid Service & Sales Design: Blueprint the service model end-to-end: which moments are digital, which are personal, and which are both. Together with RM and Sales leadership you design seamless handovers, a shared view between client app and RM workspace, and service tiers that scale high-touch quality to more clients without diluting it. Complex Offerings, Made Simple: Make sophisticated products understandable and executable: private markets with capital calls, distributions and J-curves, and the underlying funds and companies, from Cinven and Advent to Mistral and Databricks, as well as bespoke mandates, company and holding accounts, family structures and consolidated reporting across portfolios. You work closely with the Investment team, Compliance and Operations so every journey is compliant by design. Discovery, Data & Experimentation: Join advisory meetings, shadow RMs and run continuous discovery with clients for whom every interaction matters. You combine qualitative depth with rigorous measurement in a small-n, high-value segment, define tracking schemas for client and RM journeys, and use AI-assisted prototyping to converge on solutions in few iteration cycles. Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops. You drive adoption of what you ship inside the RM organization, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for hybrid wealth management at LIQID. What you bring Background: 7+ years in Product Management, ideally in wealth management, private banking, FinTech or another trust-driven, advice-led domain. Experience building for internal expert users such as advisors, sales or service teams alongside end clients is a strong plus. Service Design & Hybrid Thinking: You think in service models, not just screens. You have designed journeys that span people, processes and software, and you know how to drive adoption and behavior change inside an organization, not only ship features to it. Domain Depth & Regulatory Fluency: Solid understanding of investing and wealth management (capital markets, private markets, portfolio construction), and the ambition to build regulatory fluency in a supervised environment (MiFID II, BaFin). Experience with private market products or advisory processes is a strong plus. Analytical & Technical Fluency: You define metrics before you build and attribute impact credibly, even with small samples. You are comfortable with CRM and workflow integrations, discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers, and using AI tooling to prototype and to build AI-assisted workflows. Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English , with the presence to earn credibility with experienced Relationship Managers and with clients who expect the highest standard – and to represent your roadmap toward leadership. Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. You want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to define what a premium hybrid private client experience looks like in an AI-native product organization. What we offer Diversity : Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one. Flexibility : We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind. Appreciation : You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas. Development : We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget up to €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display. Smart Money : As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers. Well-being : Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that. What happens next An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look. Initial Call with our Talent Partner : A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role. Video Call with Head of Product : You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team. Take-home Assessment with live Presentation round : A take home task, followed by a 90-minute live session with two team members. In-Person Meeting : You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our Head of Product to discuss final alignments. About us We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit. We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust , and Project A . LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws. We are looking for a highly-motivated, business-minded Legal and Data Ethics Operations Analyst. This person will help the Data Ethics and Legal teams solve internal problems, implement goal-oriented strategies and play a key role in the Data Ethics team. You will: Coordinate data subject request management, including intake, categorization, routing, deadline tracking, documentation, communications, and closure; work with the Data Ethics team on high-risk, complex, sensitive, or multi-jurisdictional requests. Build and maintain practical playbooks, decision trees, checklists, templates, escalation criteria, and role-based guidance for recurring data ethics, privacy, legal, and regulatory processes. Manage privacy questionnaire workflows by coordinating intake, preparing AI-assisted first drafts from approved information, maintaining supporting evidence, and escalating questions requiring legal, privacy, security, or data ethics judgment. Support the design of responsible AI controls including approved-source use, permissions, confidentiality, traceability, version control, audit trails, quality checks, and human approval before material outputs are used. Study our organizational workflows and processes to recommend and implement changes to help improve business processes and optimize overall operations. Participate in creating team functional process documentation, creating presentation materials and facilitating or leading cross functional teams through projects and/or issues. Prepare operational reporting on questionnaire and request volumes, turnaround times, escalations, recurring issues, automation performance, risks, and improvement opportunities. Your team will: Our Data Ethics operations program is designed to enable LiveRamp to meet its privacy-related legal requirements and reasonable expectations of clients while minimizing and mitigating risk to LiveRamp. Our mission is to help the business find safe and legal ways to use data for the betterment of our products, services and consumers. The team operates as a connected, cross-border function that helps LiveRamp find safe, legal, ethical, and scalable ways to use data while supporting consistent execution across all locations. Strong communication and organizational skills are a must. Ability to translate complex legal, regulatory, and data ethics requirements into practical processes, playbooks, decision trees, and guidance. Experience applying AI or automation to privacy questionnaires, document or contract-template updates, knowledge retrieval, playbook creation, triage, or workflow orchestration. Hands-on experience building, configuring, or implementing AI agents, automation, or AI-assisted workflows in a controlled business environment. title: Junior Data Consultant
description: Onze Missie LOGEX is koploper in data-analyse in de gezondheidzorg. Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden Je verhoogt de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening door het valideren van financiële en zorginhoudelijke data. Je communiceert met klanten over hun data-aanlevering en de oplevering van LOGEX modellen. Je ontwikkelt je in de breedte en biedt ondersteuning aan meerdere teams en klanten als er vragen liggen met betrekking tot de kwaliteit van data. Je signaleert en realiseert kansen om interne operationele processen te verbeteren. Je draagt bij aan automatisering van onze operationele processen, mogelijk door inzet van AI. Team Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. Je werkt nauwkeurig, signaleert trends en spoort fouten of afwijkingen op. Communicatie: Je kunt effectief communiceren met diverse teamleden en interne stakeholders. Je bent resultaatgericht, werkt gestructureerd en hebt een pragmatische instelling. Bereidheid om te leren en aan te passen aan innovatieve technologieën, tools en processen. Een proactieve benadering om nieuwe taken op te pakken en kansen te zoeken om bij te dragen. Je krijgt energie van het verbeteren van werkprocessen. Taalvaardigheden: Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat wij bieden: Bij LOGEX hebben we één superkracht: data-analyse. Dabei befähigst du alle Kolleg:innen, KI im Arbeitsalltag selbstbewusst einzusetzen. Prototyping: Du baust schnell eigene KI-Tools und Prototypen, um Ideen zu testen, und entscheidest gemeinsam mit dem Team, was daraus weiterverfolgt wird. Qualifikation KI-Mindset: Du hast Bock auf KI, brennst für die schnellen Entwicklungen in diesem Bereich und willst dich und deine Arbeitsweise ständig weiterentwickeln. Claude-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits intensiv mit Claude gearbeitet und kennst seine Möglichkeiten aus der Praxis. Trendkenntnis: Du kennst die aktuellen KI-Trends und Tools und kannst einordnen, was davon Hype ist und was echten Mehrwert bringt. Praxiserfahrung: Du hast bereits eigene, coole Tools mit KI gebaut und kannst uns zeigen, was du damit erreicht hast. Programmierkenntnisse: Du bringst Programmierkenntnisse als solide Grundlage mit, um technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und eigene Prototypen umzusetzen (C# von Vorteil. Datenverständnis: Du denkst in Daten und hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie sich vorhandene Daten für den Einsatz von KI nutzen und aufbereiten lassen. Kommunikation & Vermittlung: Du erklärst komplexe KI-Themen verständlich, begeisterst auch nicht-technische Kolleg:innen und gibst dein Wissen gerne in Schulungen weiter. Hierzu verfügst du über fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und gute Englischkenntnisse. title: Head of Brand and Creative
description: Head of Brand and Creative The Role The UK is Lyrebird's most important new market, and you'll own how we show up in it. You'll also own the creative bar for everything Lyrebird makes globally. That means the taste and quality of the work, plus the operations, agencies and systems that let in-house and external teams produce world-class creative at pace. This is a senior leadership hire at a foundational moment: you'll shape how Lyrebird looks, sounds and feels as it scales. This role suits someone who moves easily between thinking about the brand and the category and caring about the quality of a single frame. You'll enjoy setting strategy in one meeting and art-directing in the next. You get as much energy from building the system behind great work as from making it, and you can hold a room of executives as comfortably as a room of creatives. If you want real influence over business outcomes and a brand you can call your own, you'll feel at home here. About Us Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians' most time-consuming tasks. We're building the medical intelligence layer for modern healthcare: a clinical AI platform that combines ambient real-time documentation, intelligent document management, clinical workflow automation, native patient data integrations across siloed health systems, and a communications layer that keeps clinicians and patients connected. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. We give clinicians richer patient information at the right moment and lighten their mental load during consults, so they can focus on delivering better care. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale. What you'll do Co-own Lyrebird's brand strategy and lead its UK rollout. This covers positioning, media, communications and campaigns that grow brand preference and trust among UK clinicians and healthcare professionals. Set and hold the creative quality and taste bar for everything Lyrebird makes globally, whether it's made in-house or by agencies. Build the creative engine: the operations, workflows, playbooks and systems that let in-house and external teams produce world-class work at volume and pace. Select, brief and manage creative and media agencies to a high standard, and decide what we build in-house and what we outsource. Design and own a brand measurement framework for a clinical audience, and report on brand health against clear goals. Shape the research and partnerships agenda that helps build the medical AI category the right way. Work closely with growth, retention, product marketing, our clinical team, product and engineering, analytics, sales, customer success and our founders, so the brand holds together across every touchpoint. What you'll bring Senior experience leading brand strategy and creative output, either at an agency or in-house at a growth-stage company, and a body of work you're proud of. A high creative bar. You set the standard, art-direct, and give sharp direction that lifts the quality of a team's work. Operational brand media depth: planning, buying and optimising integrated campaigns across digital, OOH, streaming audio, social, professional media partnerships, conference sponsorships and sponsored content. Creative operations and agency leadership. You've built the systems and managed the partners that let great work ship at pace. An audience-first instinct backed by analytical rigour. You turn insight about a professional audience into positioning, media and creative that resonate, and you're comfortable with brand measurement, including brand lift and incrementality. Strong leadership and communication, and an AI-native approach. You build and develop talent, and you use AI across creative development, planning, research and reporting. Nice to have Familiarity with healthcare or medical audience channels, such as medical associations, clinical publications and conference media. Experience in the UK or NHS healthcare market. Comfort with dashboards and marketing measurement tools such as Tableau, Sigma or Looker, and with marketing mix modelling or incrementality studies. The work you do here will shape how clinicians first come to know and trust Lyrebird, and that trust is what lets them bring it into the care they give. The stronger the brand and the work, the more clinicians reach for Lyrebird, and the more patients feel the difference. We're building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. Every deployment teaches us something about our hardware; you’ll push our R&D fleet to become one ready for large-series production: you'll own taking us from tens of robots a year to hundreds, and then thousands. You'll also keep that growing fleet deployable, and making design changes yourself to improve reliability and serviceability. Scaling a fleet means solving whatever is in the way: limited space, no clear production process, lead times we can't live with and modules that don't survive the harsh conditions of a construction site. You’ll be expected to wear many hats; we’re looking for people who are genuinely excited to lead these efforts. Our robots are built from modules at every level of maturity, so expect to work with the hardware R&D team at early stages of development to validate R&D designs as fast as we can. In parallel, you'll be in the workshop determining how we assemble them: the processes, the fixtures, the production space itself, getting the very best out of our Amsterdam facilities. For more context on building hardware at Monumental, read Niall’s Substack: I quit my job and moved country to make robots that will fix Europe’s housing crisis. What you'll do Bottom line, you'll own increasing our quarterly production from 30 sets of robot systems to 100 within a year. This is a challenge. You'll be building the production capabilities at Monumental rather than inheriting them, and you'll do it alongside engineers and technicians who care a great deal about getting this right. Take prototypes through to production-ready modules. Find and address design flaws, validate improvements, and push these modules to production. Assembling modules, understand the friction slowing production, and address issues yourself along with the hardware team. Develop fixtures, jigs and light automation solutions to support module assembly. Find production processes that bring minimal value when done in-house. Work with external suppliers to outsource them, while maintaining production quality. Produce drawings, assembly instructions and quality checks to make sure our modules are integrated together and our robots are brought up with no errors. What we're looking for Industry experience, ideally in a VC-backed start-up, transitioning products from prototype to production Hands-on, analytical mindset: skilled at building assemblies, running studies, analysing data, solving production and quality issues, and collaborating with technicians to implement and validate improvements Proficiency in mechanical assembly (press fits, fastener selection, harness, etc.) Strong knowledge of GD&T and producing 3D and 2D drawings Experience creating structured process documentation (work instructions, SOPs, quality checklists) Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken Nice-to-haves BSc in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering, or equivalent Familiarity with robotics or complex electromechanical systems Experience with ERP tools (Odoo or similar) Why Monumental? Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. title: Project Leider Bouw
description: Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk. We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural. Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie. Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf . Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken , of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet. Over de functie De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand. Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS. Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit. We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat. De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team. Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat. Wat je gaat doen De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project. Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers. Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge. Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk. Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren. Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators. Wat we zoeken Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder. Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie. Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden. Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen. Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren. Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen. Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf. Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert. Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager. Waarom Monumental? Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je. Voor open sollicitaties (als je geen rol ziet die precies past) kun je ons mailen op: Helaas bieden we op dit moment geen stageplekken aan. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen hierboven, maar ben je enthousiast over Monumental en denk je dat je ons toch kunt helpen moeilijke problemen op te lossen? Neem dan contact op. We verwelkomen generalisten die op resultaat gericht zijn en graag on the job leren. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager, KYB - MoonPay Enterprise
description: MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 , made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. About MoonPay Enterprise MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes. KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome. What You'll Own KYB product strategy & roadmap Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners. Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation. MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order. Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation. Onboarding funnel & conversion The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step. Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both. Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on. KYB API & partner experience The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once). Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it. Compliance as product Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix. EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product. Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy. Vendor & provider orchestration The verification stack (SumSub today) and the build-versus-buy calls around it. Cost per verification, automation rate, vendor performance. Know when a second provider, a waterfall, or in-house tooling earns its place. Push automation. Decide where AI-assisted review with a human in the loop replaces manual queues, and prove it does not raise risk. Every new banking provider brings its own onboarding requirements. Keep KYB compatible with every rail without collecting everything from everyone. Who You Are A principal-level PM with real KYB or KYC depth. You have owned onboarding, identity, verification, or risk as a platform, not a feature. High agency. You do not wait for a mandate, a brief, or perfect data. You find the problem, claim it, and fix it. Full autonomy, zero to one. Hand you an unowned surface and you take it from first principles to shipped. No handover document, no waiting for direction. AI-fluent by default. AI tools are your daily instruments for analysis, prototyping, and drafting. You run your own queries; analysis is not something you request from another team. Compliance is a design constraint, not a blocker. You read a requirements matrix and see API design, funnel steps, and copy. You know your funnel cold: pass rate, time-to-verified, manual review rate, cost per verification. At home in API-first B2B. Your users are partner engineers and the businesses behind them, not consumers. You have run verification vendors (SumSub, Persona, or equivalents) and know when to switch, stack, or build. A multiplier for the product team around you. You raise the bar for how compliance-heavy product work gets scoped, specced, and shipped. Bias to action. Reactive stewardship of an existing flow is not what we are hiring for. Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. title: Business Development Specialist
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. About the role This is a consultative B2B sales role focused on driving platform adoption across UK car dealerships and encouraging active daily auction participation. You’ll manage a varied portfolio of dealer partners across the UK, ranging from onboarding brand-new businesses and winning back lapsed accounts, to optimizing performance for established, regular buyers. Rather than hard-selling from a rigid script, your goal is to ask great questions, understand each dealership’s unique business goals and position the value of Motorway to demonstrate a clear ROI. You will ultimately build high-value, collaborative and long-term relationships. Whether you’re delivering a powerful first impression to a new account or embedding repeatable, profitable processes into an existing or lapsed partner's daily routine, you'll act as a trusted advisor to help them win. We don't expect you to know everything on day one, but we do look for solid sales foundations, curiosity, and a drive to learn. We’ll back you with structured coaching, dedicated mentorship, and all the tools you need to succeed. What You’ll Do Consult & Position: Conduct high-level business conversations to uncover dealership needs, positioning Motorway as an essential, long-term inventory solution. Drive Network Activity: Onboard new dealership partners, re-engage cold or lapsed accounts, and nurture regular users to drive daily auction participation. Demonstrate Value Fast: Clearly articulate ROI to new or hesitant dealers while building repeatable, sustainable buying habits for mature accounts. Pipeline Ownership: Maintain exceptional CRM hygiene using HubSpot to log activity, manage your pipeline, and report accurately. Overcome Friction: Confidently navigate objections, address dealer pain points, and follow up consistently to keep conversations moving forward. Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with cross-functional teams to resolve dealer challenges and feed market insights back to our product team. Hit Targets: Take ownership of your numbers, proactively seeking coaching and feedback whenever you spot room to grow.
