title: Senior Analytics Engineer - EMEA
description: Seeq builds advanced analytics software that unlocks insights from industrial process data—empowering companies in sectors like pharmaceuticals, oil & gas, chemicals, and power generation to optimize operations and drive business value. As a remote-first company since our founding, we’re built for collaboration across time zones. Our engineering and customer-facing teams thrive in a supportive, agile environment that emphasizes curiosity, learning, and continuous improvement. Analytics Engineers at Seeq serve as trusted technical advisors to our customers, helping them solve complex process challenges and maximize value from our software. You’ll work directly with end users to design scalable, high-impact analytics solutions that drive engagement, adoption, and tangible business outcomes. Key Duties & Responsibilities: As a key customer-facing team member, you will participate in the following activities: Customer Technical Adoption Serve as the customer’s trusted technical advisor by building relationships with champions and end-users through solution design, implementation guidance, and technical mentorship. Leverage customer relationships to perform constant discovery and uncover high-value, high-impact use case opportunities directly linked to the customer’s critical business workflows and objectives. Collaborate with the customer and account team to develop and execute strategic plans for adoption of Seeq and completion of key use cases addressing business objectives. Advise customer champions and end-users to implement and operationalize the use cases to deliver a high return on investment for the customer. Occasionally may require hands-on delivery to accelerate a customer’s high value use case. Upskill Seeq’s partner ecosystem to be an extension of the Analytics Engineering team to provide support globally and in localized languages. Product Expertise Be a product expert, maintaining knowledge of how to implement and troubleshoot solutions in the platform, including integrations with other systems. Identify gaps in Seeq's capabilities required to meet customer needs and give feedback to the product organization to influence the product roadmap. Ability to assess and position Seeq’s benefits relative to competitive products in the marketplace or in the customer’s ecosystem. Work with the product team to design, implement, and test new functionalities that meet customer needs. Industry Expertise Build trust with customers through the application of industry-specific knowledge and awareness, including market and use case trends specific to their area. Collaborate with internal teams (including industry principals, product marketing, and solution consulting) to influence industry-specific strategy. Requirements Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in a technical field such as chemical, mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering; degrees in operations research, data analytics, or applied math will be considered. Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in process engineering, reliability engineering, technical pre-sales engineering (SaaS business, OT space preferred), or other related industry fields. Deep technical expertise in one or more industrial process manufacturing verticals and a sound understanding of broad market drivers and business priorities. Examples of industrial process industries are chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power & utilities, metals & mining, food & beverage, pulp & paper, etc. Empathy with and experience in the difficulties involved in trying to solve real-world business and industrial challenges involving dense time-series process data with inadequate or overly complex analytics tools, such as Excel, MATLAB, Python, BI tools, or otherwise. Responsive and adept at building trust and rapport with customers, prospective customers, partners, and internal multidisciplinary teams. Effective and influential technical communicator. Enjoys dissecting, articulating, and translating a combination of customer-stated and customer-implied needs. Able to communicate with subject matter experts, managers, directors, and C-level audiences. Creative ability to develop and propose technical solutions leveraging the latest features and capabilities in the software and broader technology landscape. Programming experience in Python and/or other programming languages is a plus. Ability to independently prioritize work based on account team strategy, customer business needs, and Seeq company objectives. Prior experience using Seeq is highly preferred. Python programming skills is a plus. Broad knowledge of the SaaS industrial analytics ecosystem is a plus (e.g., Azure, AWS, Databricks, AVEVA, Aspen Tech, IOTA, Cognite, C3.ai, Palantir, etc.). Benefits Seeq is a remote-first (only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments. We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability. We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work. The Perks of Working at Seeq Competitive salary €111,000 - 129,000 depending on experience. Variable bonus Benefits: Unlimited PTO Generous home office allowance The best co-workers (we've analyzed the data, so we know it's true.) Pet-friendly workspace (your dog will be so happy to have you home) You love your job! Seeq provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. title: Senior Account Executive, DACH (German-speaking, Hamburg)
company: Senior Software Engineer, Gamified Security Awareness (Full-Stack)
description: Our mission and why it matters We are on a mission to make humans the strongest security layer. Human risk remains one of the biggest vulnerabilities and traditional awareness training is not enough. We take a different approach by combining AI-driven personalization, real threat detection, and behavioral science to actively protect people and organizations. We don't just simulate risks. We build the tools that detect and stop them. Why this role matters The DACH region is currently our largest growth market in EMEA, generating an incredible amount of pipeline. With a highly certified product and an exceptional service that customers genuinely love, we have laid a strong foundation. We are now looking for a highly self-motivated Senior Account Executive who excels at taking those enterprise opportunities, multi-threading to economic buyers, and guiding them successfully through complex procurement cycles. You will be joining a team that has already proven it can support companies in seeing the value of the service, making this a prime opportunity to drive significant revenue rather than a speculative territory. Crucially, as our business results grow, you will be instrumental in helping us lay the groundwork for our future local hub in the Hamburg area. What you’ll own and drive You will take full ownership of the sales cycle for enterprise accounts in the DACH market, expertly guiding deals from initial pipeline through complex procurement to closed-won. Driving multi-threaded deals is second nature to you, as you reach economic buyers early and confidently hold the line on price objections. You will lead POC-led selling initiatives with real, concrete exit criteria to ensure successful outcomes, all while partnering closely with an SDR to prioritize opportunities and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene with customer-owned next steps. What success looks like • In your first 3 months you'll be fully onboarded, deeply understand our qualification framework, and have a few opportunities moving past the initial stages with real, dated next steps. • By month 6, you'll operate independently, managing an active pipeline, progressing opportunities consistently to late stage pipeline, and building your new business ARR towards quota. What makes you thrive here You have native-level or full business proficiency in German, alongside strong working proficiency in English, and several years of experience as a closing AE in B2B SaaS. Specifically, you have a proven track record of taking deals through procurement in fast-paced software or licensing sales, rather than just generating them. You bring a strong commercial backbone and comfort with multi-threading to an economic buyer before a proposal ever goes out. Above all, you have a team-first mindset with forecast honesty—you own your pipeline and embrace a collaborative, winning-together attitude. You are a true self-starter who is phenomenal at what you currently do, taking pride in driving significant impact as a senior individual contributor. To support our near-future vision of opening a physical hub in Germany, we are looking for candidates who are ideally already based in the wider Hamburg region. Bonus points if you also bring experience with 3 to 6 month enterprise buying cycles and committees, or prior exposure to regulated DACH verticals like manufacturing, healthcare, or financial services. A background in cybersecurity, GRC, or compliance software is highly valued, as is a habit of leveraging technology creatively in your daily workflow. Who you’ll work with You will be a key part of our EMEA Sales Team, reporting to our EMEA Head of Sales. This DACH-focused role is working in a highly supportive AE group focusing on the EMEA market. We are committed to a collaborative culture but you will also be given independence to run your opportunities. You will find a team that asks for something back on every concession, owns their forecast misses honestly, and truly lives by a team-first standard that shows up in how we actually operate, rather than just as an aspiration on a slide. What you can expect from us • Compensation: Monthly fixed base salary of € 6000 - € 7000 depending on your experience (plus a 50/50 base and commission model featuring accelerated earnings for the first 12 months). You may notice varying salary ranges for roles with similar titles across Hoxhunt; this is because each range is grounded in our role leveling and reflects the seniority, scope, and impact expectations required for that specific role and team, and we operate with a low hierarchy. • Working ways: You will start by working remotely from the Hamburg region. However, as we are planning to build a hub in Hamburg in the near future, this will eventually transform into a hybrid role. You will enjoy a flexible work setting with opportunities to travel and connect with the broader team. • High performance meets high humanity: We bring an incredibly driven, high-impact energy to our work, but we leave our egos at the door. You will be surrounded by wildly talented, dedicated colleagues in an environment built on extreme kindness, support, and psychological safety. • Authentic trust & autonomy: We hire great people and trust them to do great work. You will find a culture free of micromanagement, giving you the autonomy to take real ownership, drive impact, and shape things early on. • A product you can be proud of: It is incredibly rare in cybersecurity to build a multi-award-winning product that end-users genuinely love. You will join a fast-paced, technically sophisticated team making a real, measurable impact against cybercrime, backed by strong financial stability and growth. • The perks that matter: Alongside this amazing community, you will enjoy extensive healthcare with other benefits tailored for our team in Germany. To ensure your personal data is handled securely and in compliance with GDPR, we only accept applications submitted through our application form. We cannot process applications sent via other channels, such as email or LinkedIn messages. Our Recruitment Process Interview with Talent Acquisition (remote, 30 min) Interview with EMEA Head of Sales (remote, 45 min) Take-home assignment and panel (on-site in Helsinki, 90 min) Reference checks and offer About Hoxhunt Hoxhunt was founded in 2016 by four visionaries. Today we are a global team of +300 amazing Hoxhunters advancing a truly AI-native category leader in human risk management, with key hubs in the United States, the United Kingdom, Singapore, and Finland. We are proud to be an award-winning, fast-growing software company, recognized by G2 and Gartner, named to TIME Magazine's list of the World's Top EdTech Companies, and featured for our innovation in major publications like Fast Company, TechCrunch, Forbes, and Inc. As a multi-product company, Hoxhunt goes beyond traditional security awareness. We don't just educate employees through frequent, personalized, and behavior-changing cybersecurity training - we also actively build real threat intelligence and response tools that protect organizations against malicious cyberattacks every single day. Be among the first to know about our open positions. Drop your details in our Talent Community, and we will reach out when there is a match! title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: Our Purpose At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. About Us SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. What Are We Looking For? We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. Wir arbeiten bereits mit einigen der coolsten Marken in der DACH-Region und darüber hinaus – darunter Unternehmen wie IKEA, LVMH oder GetYourGuide – und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir unser Portfolio noch weiter ausbauen! Baue Beziehungen und ein Netzwerk mit C-Level-Führungskräften großer Unternehmen in der DACH-Region und im Learning & Development-Bereich auf. Du gehst proaktiv auf neue Kontakte zu, identifizierst, qualifizierst und entwickelst deine eigene Sales-Pipeline – du hast die volle Verantwortung und entwickelst Strategien, um den Umsatz zu steigern, Leads zu generieren und Deals abzuschließen. Du prognostizierst deine Vertriebsaktivitäten und Umsätze, während du dafür sorgst, dass unsere Kund:innen rundum zufrieden sind. Arbeite eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen, vor allem mit Marketing und Product Experience, um für unsere Kund:innen das Beste rauszuholen. Erreiche (und übertreffe) deine Ziele Wir glauben, du bist erfolgreich, wenn du so ein Typ Mensch bist: Hunter-Mentalität: Du blühst in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld richtig auf. Unermüdlicher Macher: „Ausrede“ gibt’s bei dir nicht. Du hast bewiesen, dass du Dinge erledigst. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für jede Idee, setzt dir Ziele, holst andere ins Boot und ziehst alles bis ins Detail durch – egal was es braucht, um das Ziel zu erreichen. Kundenversteher: Du fühlst dich in einer Kultur wohl, in der Kundenerfolg immer an erster Stelle steht, und gibst alles, um das Erlebnis und Leben unserer Kunden zu verbessern. You will also want to work in AI and understand the nuances of law as it relates to AI, including the evolving regulatory frameworks. Sierra is a unique place to work, with a strong sense of togetherness, and the legal team is no exception. A proactive mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. Even better… Experience of privacy/regulatory frameworks and can advise on data processing agreements and security-related contract provisions. Non-English languages, especially Spanish, German and French. A passion for AI, with a deep understanding of AI products, LLMs and the related legal issues. Law firm experience at a top-tier, internationally recognized law firm. Experience working at a high-growth startup and operating with a sense of ownership. Industry specific knowledge in any of the following: Financial Services, Healthcare, Telecoms, Insurance and/or Consumer. Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it. Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. title: Principal MEMS Development Engineer
description: About SiTime SiTime Corporation is the precision timing company. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power and better reliability. With more than 3 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit www.sitime.com . Job Summary Join the team that is revolutionizing the timing industry with the best silicon Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS) timing products in the world. As a Principal MEMS Development Engineer, you will use your technical and creative problem-solving skills to push forward MEMS technology and engineer resonators for SiTime’s next-generation timing products. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position. Responsibilities: Lead definition and execution of challenging technical projects. Advise management of challenges, impact, recommendations. Develop new or improved resonators, MEMS technologies and/or products. Design MEMS devices and characterize their electrical, mechanical, and thermal performance on wafer level and/or device level. Work with process team to drive continuous improvement in MEMS yields. Extend and enhance automated infrastructure for MEMS design, measurements, and data analysis. Design and analyze experiments to understand device physics, materials, and fabrication. Interface with local and overseas vendors. Work in cross-functional teams, including circuits, systems, and packaging. Working/supporting other projects as needed. Qualifications & Requirements: Ph.D. in ME, EE, Physics, or equivalent At least 3 years of industry experience. Skilled scientist with ability to design, conduct, and analyze experiments. Excellent problem identification and problem-solving abilities. Excellent knowledge of mechanics, electrodynamics, thermodynamics. Knowledge in fundamentals of MEMS devices physics and fabrication. Experience with finite element simulation tools (COMSOL, ANSYS) and data processing tools (Matlab, Python). Excellent interpersonal, organizational, written and verbal communication skills. Passion for delivering exceptional results. Desired Characteristics & Attributes: 3 -10 years of industry experience. Intermediate to advanced knowledge of programing languages, circuits, metrology equipment and methods. Experience with Statistical analysis and tools such as R or JMP. Knowledge in MEMS microfabrication. Compensation Range: At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. title: (Senior) Backend Engineer C++ (All Genders)
description: At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments. We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions. WHY JOIN US The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty. You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms. We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing. About the Team Minerva is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Minerva team is a small, senior software group based in Berlin and Munich, working directly with our systems and hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities deployed in active operational environments. We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field. Your Mission This is not a "standard" backend role. You won't be building CRUD apps for a web store. You will be building the high-performance, low-latency engine at the heart of Minerva Frontline, our Command & Control (C2) Software, enabling mission planning and operations of Aerial and Maritime asset swarms in real world conditions. We are looking for C++ developers to build out our core server-side architecture enabling the increasingly complex CONOPS required by NATO’s Armed forces. You will be responsible for how we maintain a global battlefield state, how we translate high-level operator intents into machine-executable actions, and how we stream real-time telemetry to the frontline. You will work in a high-density engineering environment alongside robotics, safety, and mission planning experts. title: Network Engineer
description: About the role Help build the networks connecting SkyNRG’s offices and future production sites! title: Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01
description: Please note: For this role proficiency in both Dutch and English is required. Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01 As Reliability & Maintenance Engineer DSL-01, you are responsible for building and continuously improving the facility's maintenance, reliability, and asset integrity framework. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you help ensure the plant operates safely, reliably, and efficiently. The role starts with a strong Maintenance Engineering focus. Your priority will be to help establish the maintenance and reliability foundation of DSL-01 by answering a fundamental question: "how do we maintain our assets safely, reliably, and efficiently throughout their lifecycle?" You will translate reliability studies, equipment criticality assessments, and integrity requirements into practical maintenance plans, inspection programmes, spare parts strategies, and asset management processes. As the facility moves into stable operations, the focus gradually shifts towards Reliability Engineering, where you will use asset health monitoring, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent failures and improve long-term asset performance. Working closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external specialists, you will help reduce technical risk and improve asset reliability from day one. You will: Develop and continuously improve maintenance, inspection, and asset integrity strategies Translate reliability studies, FMECA analyses, and engineering data into practical maintenance plans within the CMMS/EAM system Act as owner of the asset register from a maintenance, reliability, and integrity perspective Support the implementation and continuous development of the facility's CMMS/EAM system Drive reliability improvements through asset health monitoring, KPI analysis, and predictive maintenance techniques Lead Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective actions Monitor and improve reliability performance indicators such as MTBF, MTTR, availability, and inspection compliance Support asset improvement, modification, and long-term replacement strategies throughout the asset lifecycle Your profile As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and enjoys turning complex technical challenges into practical solutions. You recognize yourself in the following: Must have Fluent in Dutch and English Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering discipline (i.e. electrical or mechanical) 5+ years of experience in Reliability Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, Asset Integrity, or Asset Management Experience with RCM, FMEA/FMECA, RCA, and maintenance strategy development Experience with CMMS/EAM systems such as SAP PM, Maximo, or IFS Preferred Experience in chemical, petrochemical, energy, or other process industries like food or FMCG Experience with CMMS/EAM implementation or optimisation Experience with predictive maintenance and condition monitoring Knowledge of ATEX, PED, and asset integrity management About DSL-01 DSL-01 is SkyNRG’s frontrunning renewable fuels facility in Delfzijl, Netherlands. The plant will produce Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) from residual fats and greases using the HEFA (Hydrotreated Esters and Fatty Acids) pathway, with additional renewable products like butane, propane, and naphtha as by-products. DSL-01 is the first facility in Europe dedicated entirely to SAF and its by-products. Once operational, it will produce 100,000 tonnes of SAF and 35,000 tonnes of sustainable by-products per year, cutting greenhouse gas emissions by around 80% compared to conventional jet fuel. Construction started in 2026, with first fuel expected in 2028. The project includes the main facility, pipelines, and temporary work areas. At DSL-01, you will be part of a team building a state-of-the-art industrial plant from the ground up, contributing to a truly sustainable energy future. We are committed to offering an attractive total package to ensure we attract the best talent in the market. This includes a competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and a range of benefits that support your personal and professional growth. Is this you? description: Who We Are Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. You would keep the cell lines healthy and run the assays that show how a designed protein behaves on a living cell, week after week, to the same standard. About us AI for biology has a data problem. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team. The role You will run cell culture and the cell-based assays for our protein characterisation work. That means the mammalian lines the assays depend on, from thaw through routine passage to a banked and documented stock, and the weekly rhythm of seeding, treating, reading and reporting plates. You will run those assays as designed, with the controls and replicates that make a curve defensible, and you will be the person who notices when a plate, a line or a reagent lot has started to drift. Assay design and the shape of the cascade sit with the scientist who leads this work today, so you are not being asked to invent the panel. You are being asked to make it run the same way every week, to record what you did in a form the rest of the system can read, and to tighten the protocols as they settle, including moving them towards the plate formats our automation will take on. Your first 90 days FIRST 30 DAYS ◆ Take over routine culture and banking for the protein cell lines, working to the protocols we already run. ◆ Learn the panel end to end by running each assay alongside the scientist who owns it. DAYS 30 TO 60 ◆ Run at least one assay in the panel independently, including its controls and acceptance criteria. ◆ Revise one culture or assay protocol so that someone else could follow it without asking you. DAYS 60 TO 90 ◆ Hold the weekly assay schedule on your own and return results on the agreed turnaround. ◆ Bring one protocol to a tighter precision bar, or into a plate format ready for automation. Who you are You are a hands-on cell biologist who takes assay variability personally. You have run the same assay often enough to tell a real effect from a bad plate, and you would rather find the cause than repeat the run. The week has a rhythm in this job: cells to feed, plates to seed, runs to finish, numbers to return. You are happy with that, you keep records someone else can pick up, and you say early when something looks wrong rather than at the end of the week. We do not hire people into boxes. The team is small, and early hires here end up owning work beyond the job they joined for. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you. MUST HAVE ◆ Strong hands-on mammalian cell culture: adherent and suspension lines, aseptic technique, and thawing, passaging and banking to a high and consistent standard. ◆ Experience running cell-based assays end to end, including relevant controls, replicates and dose-response curves behind a reported number. ◆ Comfort with plate-based work and the arithmetic that goes with it, such as dilution series, plate maps and normalisation. ◆ Careful, traceable record-keeping that someone else can follow without asking you. ◆ A PhD in cell biology, pharmacology, immunology or a related field, or an MSc and two to three years of relevant lab experience. NICE TO HAVE ◆ Reporter cell line bioassays for binding or blockade. ◆ Receptor internalisation, lysosomal trafficking or cytotoxicity assays. ◆ High-content or fluorescence imaging, and the image analysis behind it. ◆ 384-well formats, liquid handlers or other plate-based automation. ◆ Flow cytometry, for example for surface receptor quantification. Why this is unusual Most cell-based assay roles sit inside a discovery project. You build an assay, you answer a question with it, and the assay goes quiet. This one is closer to running an instrument. The same assays run every week against a stream of new molecules, and the number that comes out is the product. That changes what good looks like. Precision matters more than novelty, a protocol is only finished when someone else can run it and get your answer, and every passage, plate and reagent lot is captured as structured data, because a result is only as trustworthy as the cells behind it. Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. Worth knowing in advance which one you are. How we work This is a lab-based role at our site in King's Cross, London. The cells are in the lab, so most of your week will be too, with room for writing and analysis away from the bench. The wider team is distributed and travels, so you will work with people who are not always in the building. We work in the open. Decisions are written down, work happens centrally rather than scattered across tools, and the week opens with a session the whole company attends. There is a quarterly offsite. Each person owns their area and makes the call inside it, and we will expect that of you early rather than late. UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and top-tier Bupa private health cover. More is added as the team grows. The team you will join You will join the protein characterisation team and report to its lead. Day to day you will work with the scientist who designs the assay cascade, with the protein production and molecular characterisation scientists upstream of you, with the functional genomics team who share the cell culture suite, and with the engineers building the software and automation the lab runs on. We are a small, elite team, and this is the first seat given entirely to the cell-based side of the work. Our process Our process has four stages. A short screening call about the role and the practicalities. A behavioural interview about how you work, run from the same template for every candidate, before anything technical. A technical stage with the protein characterisation team, built around real work rather than a puzzle, including time with us in person at the lab. Then references, aimed at whatever we still want to understand. If you are not sure whether you match every line above, apply anyway. We would rather read it and decide. title: Founding Growth Marketer

Build and look after the route to a demo: landing pages, the booking flow, qualifying questions, quick follow-up and a clean handover to sales. Clicks, impressions and ROAS only matter as far as they get us there. After your first month, tracking is set up properly, you've agreed the list of target brands with sales, and your first campaign is running. After your first quarter, demos and sign-ups come in every week from channels you set up, and you know what each one costs by channel. Skip this one if Your best campaigns needed an agency to run them. You report clicks and impressions and call it pipeline. You'd rather write the plan than ship the campaign. Most brand leaders haven't yet seen AI that takes actions on their business. You'll shape how they first hear about it. You'll work alongside both founders, who ran commerce brands before building software. Decisions are quick, and what you hear from the market gets into the product fast. You can use our agents on your own work from your first day. How we hire A 30-minute intro call with the co-founders. title: Software Engineer, AI Enablement
description: Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic! About Tailscale Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital. About the Role We're seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer, AI Enablement to help Tailscale's engineering organization get the most out of AI-assisted development. You'll join a small, high-leverage team reporting to our co-founder, working alongside our first AI enablement engineer to build the tools, workflows, and practices that help every engineer at Tailscale build faster and more safely with AI. This is a foundational role — you'll have real latitude to shape what AI enablement means here as we scale, with direct visibility into how the whole engineering org adopts these tools. Key Responsibilities Partner with engineering leadership and Tailscale's technical staff to define and drive our internal AI-enablement roadmap. Work closely with the team building Aperture by Tailscale, our AI gateway used both internally and offered as a product. Build and iterate on the tools, workflows, and shared practices that help engineers get real value from coding agents — and evaluate new models and tools, making clear calls on what we adopt. Partner with engineering and non-engineering teams to find high-leverage opportunities to apply AI — this is a support function, so success means other teams shipping faster because of what you've built. Establish the guardrails, review practices, and documentation that make AI-generated code safe to ship, and act as the internal advocate who helps teams adopt good practices without mandating a single tool. Track adoption and measure the real impact of AI tooling on velocity and quality, and report back to leadership. What We Are Looking For 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Genuine, daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or similar) — real power-user experience, not occasional use Experience building and shipping internal tools or developer-facing automation Strong written and verbal communication and internal advocacy skills — comfortable teaching, writing, and influencing engineers at very different comfort levels with AI tooling A balanced approach — trying to get people to use AI effectively and safely where appropriate. We don't have an 'AI mandate'; we believe that if we make AI both easy to use and safe, people will choose to use it when appropriate. Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed prioritization on a small, still-forming team Product or systems thinking — able to identify and prioritize high-leverage opportunities, not just execute a pre-set roadmap Nice to Have Prior experience in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs and coding agents Experience with a systems language such as Go or Rust, in addition to Python Background in security or code-review practices — helpful for reasoning about AI/agent-generated code, though you don't need to be a security engineer Experience in developer relations, technical evangelism, or customer-facing developer advocacy — the same skills that make someone effective in external DevRel translate well to driving internal AI adoption Technical project management experience As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set. UK Pay Range £128,770 — £178,540 GBP What We Offer An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life. A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles). Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family! Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description. Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation. Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration. Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! A build-your-own home office setup. title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
description: Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager in our Berlin or London offices. About the Role Taktile is building the world's leading Agentic Decisioning Platform for Financial Services. Our customers use our product to automate millions of critical decisions with AI across customer onboarding, credit underwriting, anti money laundering, and many other use cases. Underneath every one of these decisions sits the Taktile Platform: the permissions, environments, deployment, extensibility and connectivity foundations that allow the largest financial institutions to run Taktile securely and at scale, for both humans and AI agents. Taktile Platform also owns developer productivity: the tooling, infrastructure and workflows that help our engineering teams ship quickly and safely. As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the strategy and roadmap for the platform, with a focus on its enterprise and agentic foundations. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure and security engineering to meet the demands of a rapidly growing enterprise customer base, and partner with customer-facing teams and Product Marketing to make our platform a reason customers choose Taktile. What You’ll Do Own the strategy and long-term success of the Taktile Platform, the foundation that every product area and every enterprise customer builds on Define a compelling long-term vision for the platform and prioritize the roadmap necessary to reach it. Example areas of focus will include permissions for users and AI agents, Taktile MCP extensibility, release processes (e.g. environments), enterprise connectivity, and more Build a deep understanding of enterprise requirements (security, IT, compliance and procurement), the competitive landscape and opportunities for differentiation, collaborating with customer-facing teams Translate customer insights into well thought out product requirements Balance innovation with a very high bar for reliability and security Act as the voice of the platform: enable and advocate for platform capabilities across product, engineering and go-to-market teams, and partner with Product Marketing to bring them to market Track adoption and performance of platform capabilities through metrics and customer feedback, identifying opportunities for iteration Who You Are 5+ yrs work experience in Product Management, including previous experience owning platform topics (e.g. identity and access management, permissions, environments, deployment models, connectivity or developer platforms) for B2B SaaS or AI products Strong technical depth and an appetite to keep deepening it. An engineering or other technical background is preferred. You are comfortable going deep with engineers on cloud infrastructure, authentication and authorization (e.g. OAuth, SSO, SCIM) and networking. Experience in building critical, high-availability systems is a strong plus Experience working with enterprise security, IT and compliance stakeholders, for example through security reviews, RFPs or complex customer deployments. Familiarity with AI agents and MCP is a must, familiarity with and with financial services is desired Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to build trust and influence decisions across functions, and to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences alike Track record of delivering lasting customer impact through shipping well-thought out product improvements Aptitude and appetite for using data to inform your decision-making Hands-on, curious, and willing to challenge yourself and grow your scope of responsibilities over time Our Offer Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you, and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe including the founders of Looker, Datadog, GitHub, and UiPath Enjoy annual offsites where the entire company co-locates to collaborate in person Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package as well as access to a self-development budget Work at our prime office locations in Berlin or London for three days per week or more Our Stance We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears About Us Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. description: Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle. At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Sales Director, EMEA This is a senior sales opportunity for an experienced commercial leader to drive Talos’s growth with banks and TradFi institutions as institutional finance moves into digital assets and tokenized, multi-asset trading. As Sales Director at Talos, you will own new business and key relationships across the UK, with a focus on banks and TradFi institutions entering digital assets. Use and expand your network of senior bank and TradFi relationships to build a high-quality pipeline from day one. Lead senior-level discovery and demo conversations, mapping institutional workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities. Position Talos clearly within the evolving digital asset ecosystem, translating TradFi requirements across connectivity, risk, compliance and workflow into Talos’s value proposition. An established network of active relationships across banks and TradFi institutions, particularly in the UK and Europe. Experience in FX, fixed income, equities or multi-asset trading environments is highly valued. Familiarity with digital assets is advantageous but not required. You should bring genuine interest in how TradFi is adopting digital assets and tokenization. The ability to lead consultative, senior-level sales conversations and explain complex infrastructure in clear, client-friendly terms. Strong commercial judgment, with the discipline to set realistic client expectations and avoid overcommitting on product or timelines. A self-directed, high-ownership approach: you can build a pipeline and maintain momentum independently, without ramp-up or close guidance. A collaborative, team-first mindset, comfortable in a fast-paced, distributed environment with a high degree of autonomy. Based in London, or able to work from the London office. We take the time to understand a client's workflows, constraints, and goals before positioning a solution. We sell what we have - with deep product mastery and honest conversations about what's on the roadmap and what isn't. By connecting LLMs to high-quality, trustworthy web content, we help developers build agents that are not only intelligent — but also informed. Das bringst Du mit Erfahrung: Du verfügst über eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Berufserfahrung oder einen vergleichbaren Hintergrund und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundensupport oder in der Auftragsabwicklung mit. Kommunikationstalent: Du hast Freude am Kundenkontakt und kommunizierst stets freundlich, sicher und auf den Punkt. title: Chef d'équipe logistique (H/F)
description: En bref Picnic grandit vite, et notre centre de préparation de commandes de Moissy-Cramayel a besoin de pilotes pour porter cette ambition. Manager environ 20 Shoppers (préparateur(rice)s de commandes) en direct, garantir une sécurité totale et transformer chaque shift en succès collectif avec +100 Shoppers sur le terrain. Assurer la polyvalence opérationnelle : Réception, gestion des stocks (sec, frais, surgelé) ou départ des camions... tu navigues entre les zones selon les besoins du planning. Gérer l'humain et le terrain : Tu es le point de contact privilégié pour ton équipe, capable de recadrer avec pédagogie comme de féliciter les réussites. Tu maîtrises le français (l'anglais est un plus) et tu es parfaitement à l'aise avec les outils digitaux de pilotage. Tu es véhiculé(e) pour rejoindre facilement l'entrepôt de Moissy-Cramayel. You’ll join our Employer Branding team and help shape how candidates experience Picnic, with a particular focus on our LinkedIn page and campaigns. You’ll create and edit visual content for our employer brand, combining design and video to tell stories that catch people’s attention. You’ll also take ownership of the processes behind our LinkedIn campaigns: helping plan content, coordinate assets, publish posts and keep campaigns running smoothly. From a first idea to the final edit and post, you’ll help make sure our content feels distinctive, engaging and true to Picnic. You’ll work with colleagues across Employer Branding and our wider Creative team of 20+ specialists, including designers, videographers and copywriters. Tricks of the trade Create employer brand content: Design and edit visuals and videos for Picnic’s LinkedIn page, campaigns and other employer branding channels. Own LinkedIn campaign processes: Help plan campaign content, coordinate the assets and timelines, publish posts and keep the process organised from start to finish. Bring stories to life: Turn ideas, interviews and raw footage into clear, engaging content that shows what it’s like to work at Picnic. Adapt content for different formats: Resize and refine designs and edits for different channels and placements, while keeping the look and message consistent. title: Events & Community Manager
description: About us: Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the role: Restaurant owners trust other restaurant owners. They listen to the chef down the street, their wine supplier and their accountant long before they listen to an ad. That's why our events work. When we launched in Berlin, we hosted a four-hands dinner with two local merchants and a well-known food creator. We believe that’s what builds credibility, trust, and ultimately a warm prospect list. We’re hiring an Events & Community Manager to turn that into a program that runs in several markets at the same time. You’ll plan and run our partner and owned events, and find new ways to grow Tebi through the hospitality community in each city, neighbourhood and market. You’ll work closely with our local sales teams so every event and partnership turns into real conversations. This is a hands-on role. One week you'll be hosting a merchant dinner in Milan, the next you'll be setting up a distributor breakfast in Amsterdam. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our Marketing team to extend these programs to our channel ecosystem, plus align closely with the General Managers and Account Managers in each market. What you'll be doing: Run events across markets: Plan and deliver partner and owned events in 2–3 markets at a time, from intimate merchant dinners and industry breakfasts to city launches. You own the calendar, budget, venues, suppliers, guest lists and the plan for the night. Build the playbook as you go: Turn each event into templates, checklists and supplier lists, so we can launch a city campaign in weeks, not months. Improve them after every event. Build local partner networks: Find the people operators already trust: drinks distributors, wholesalers, food creators, hospitality associations, accountants and the advisers who help new venues open. Build partnerships that bring us introductions and referrals, not just logos. Put our merchants front and center: Work with our best merchants as hosts and anchors, so prospects hear about Tebi from the people they respect. Turn connections into pipeline: Agree with local Sales and Account Management who to involve, how to follow up and who owns what conversations. Track every event in HubSpot from invite to demo to signed merchant. Grow Tebi through the community: Find new ways to reach operators through the people and places they already trust, in each city, neighborhood and across borders. Keep guests and partners engaged after events, so one introduction leads to the next. Open new community channels: Test new ways to grow through our close-knit industry, such as an affiliate or referral program for partners, sharing useful insights from our merchants, and showing up in the forums and groups where operators talk shop. Capture the stories: Work with our creative team and relevant freelancers to turn events and partner moments into social content, case studies and sales material. How we'll measure success: Events delivered each quarter across markets, on time and on budget Demos, pipeline and new merchants from each event and partnership Introductions, referrals and leads from partners, affiliates and community channels Cost per demo compared with our other channels What you’ll bring: Have built something people show up for: an event series, a supper club, a community, a program. You can point to what it led to, not just how many people came Feel at home in hospitality. You've worked in or around restaurants, bars or food and drink brands, and you're comfortable leading a room full of operators Are high agency. You own your calendar, your relationships and your results, and you don't wait to be told what to do Build your own playbook when there isn't one, and you enjoy doing the work as much as planning it Know the difference between a real community and a guest list See growth opportunities beyond events, and are curious enough to test them Can run several markets at once without dropping details, and are happy to travel regularly Track what you do: comfortable with a CRM (HubSpot a plus), UTMs and simple reporting Speak fluent English. Dutch, German, Italian, Spanish or a Nordic language is a plus Typically this means 3–5 years in events, community, field marketing or partnerships, but we care more about what you've built than how long you've been doing it. This role isn't for you if: You'd rather plan the program than run it You need a fixed playbook and a clear org chart to get going You're not willing to roll up your sleeves on the night Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary Lunch Provided in Office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Finance / FP&A (m/w/d)
description: Du machst unser Wachstum steuerbar. TEILE entwickelt und produziert High-End-Lautsprecher, DJ- und Audio-Equipment sowie Merch – Design-Objekte mit kompromisslosem Klang, von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Produkt. Eine Brand, die man nicht nur hört, sondern auch tragen will. Unsere Lautsprecher prägen den Sound von ausgewählten Clubs, Festivals, Bars, Hotels und Restaurants weltweit. Hinter TEILE steht eine weltweite Community mit sehr hoher Reichweite auf Instagram – Menschen, die unsere Produkte nicht nur kaufen, sondern zeigen, teilen und weitertragen. Gerade bauen wir neue Vertriebskanäle auf: eigener Onlineshop, Social Commerce, Handels- und Objektpartner sowie Kooperationen mit großen Marken. Wir wachsen schnell – und bisher ohne Finanzfunktion. Es gibt kein Controlling, keine strukturierte Datenbasis, keine Systeme, die miteinander sprechen. Genau das baust du auf – von der ersten Zeile an. Deine Mission Du wirst die Person, die TEILE steuerbar macht. Du bringst den Blick eines CFO mit und baust trotzdem gern selbst – vom ersten Forecast bis zur Datenpipeline. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit unserem CEO und dem Gründerteam zusammen und machst KI von Anfang an zum Kern unserer Steuerung: automatisierte Reportings, datenbasierte Entscheidungen und smarte Prozesse statt manueller Routinen. Deine Aufgaben Finance & FP&A aufbauen: Planung, Forecast, Liquidität und Reporting – mit einer Steuerungslogik, die mit uns skaliert. Profitabilität sichtbar machen: Deckungsbeiträge pro Produkt, Kanal und Projekt – von der Werkstatt bis zum Webshop. Finanzierung begleiten: Darlehen, Working-Capital-Finanzierung und Investoren-Unterlagen. Eine Datenbasis für alle: Shop-, Marketing-, Produktions-, Vertriebs- und Finanzdaten in einer Plattform zusammenführen (z. B. Shopify) – Dashboards statt Excel-Silos. AI-First denken: KI und Automatisierung produktiv in Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain und Customer Service bringen. Tech-Landschaft verantworten: Tools auswählen, Systeme verbinden, externe Dienstleister steuern. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Finance, Controlling oder FP&A – idealerweise in einem produzierenden Unternehmen mit physischen Produkten Du hast Planung, Controlling und Reporting schon einmal selbst aufgebaut – nicht nur übernommen Ein Plus: Hintergrund bei einer Big-4-Gesellschaft (PwC, KPMG, EY, Deloitte) Datenaffinität: BI-Tools, Data-Warehouse-Logik, gern SQL – du baust selbst mit Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und Prozessautomatisierung Strategisch denkend, hands-on, pragmatisch – du brauchst kein großes Team, um zu liefern Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse Ebenfalls ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Shopify und D2C Das erwartet dich Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum – du baust deinen Bereich von null auf Direkter Draht zu CEO und Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege Ein Produkt, das man hört: High-End-Sound an besonderen Orten weltweit Starkes Wachstum, neue Kanäle, internationale Projekte – und die Perspektive, ein eigenes Team aufzubauen Homeoffice nach Absprache Arbeitsmodell Standort Freiburg im Breisgau (Produktion) oder Berlin Vollzeit Regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort an beiden Standorten Lust, TEILE mit aufzubauen? description: Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location. Expansion should follow initial production success, not just an impressive proof of concept. Early success means building an exceptional initial team, identifying a defensible set of priority markets and named accounts, personally helping progress lighthouse deals and establishing replicable wins. Longer term, we want a European enterprise organization that can forecast reliably and grow without requiring bespoke execution on every account. You're a builder who still enjoys customers, recruiting and deals. You don't need a fully formed regional machine before you can produce results. title: People Operations Partner
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity. tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators. We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership. We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. 🚀 The Role We're hiring a People Operations Partner to join our Performance team. tem is rebuilding the energy transaction - transparent, fair and built on trust. Behind that mission is a company growing fast, and a Performance team that's already lean and stretched. Core People operations needs more firepower as we scale, and there's a direct commercial angle too: a strong People Operations function is what lets new joiners ramp up and become productive faster once they arrive. This is a multi-disciplinary People Operations role at the centre of the employee lifecycle - equal parts operational delivery, automation and continuous improvement. You'll be the reliable hands keeping People processes running as we scale, from multi-country payroll to onboarding, employee changes and offboarding. You'll also build the tools, automations and lightweight AI workflows that connect our systems (Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n and Google Workspace), so the function doesn't need to double in size every time headcount does. In your first 12 months, you might: Take ownership of payroll across our UK and employer-of-record employees, keeping every cycle accurate and on time as pay schedules and countries multiply. Become the trusted point of contact for employees and managers, owning their queries through to resolution. Build the automations and AI-enabled workflows that remove repetitive manual work from the employee lifecycle. Turn recurring pain points into better processes, tools or self-service, and measure whether they actually worked. Move across People disciplines as priorities shift - reward and benchmarking, pensions and options administration, performance cycles, engagement and people data. 🛠️ Responsibilities Run payroll end to end: own monthly payroll across UK and employer-of-record employees - changes, corrections, off-cycle and ex-gratia payments, contractor payroll and invoicing, and country-specific items - keeping it accurate and on time as we add pay schedules and countries. Keep the lifecycle running: deliver core People operations across onboarding, employee changes, contracts and documentation, leave, mobility (visas and international moves), EOR and contractor setup, and offboarding, flexing into whatever the business needs most. Be the trusted point of contact: own employee and manager queries through to resolution with a clear response standard, rather than passing them between functions. Keep the foundations accurate: maintain employee data, documentation and systems so that everything else can depend on them. Automate the repeatable: build and maintain automations and lightweight AI-enabled tools, workflows and agents that connect Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n, Google Workspace and similar, and remove repetitive manual work - with controls so speed never costs accuracy, privacy or employee trust. Own the People tech stack: evolve our People technology ecosystem - evaluate emerging tools, consolidate where we can, and simplify the architecture. Improve continuously: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, measure whether they worked, and give foundational People processes a named owner and a runbook someone else could follow cold. Design to delight and to scale: we treat our people like top athletes and aim to delight at every step of the employee journey, and what works at today's size shouldn't need twice the People team when headcount doubles - default to eliminating or automating work rather than administering it. Partner across the business: work with Finance, Legal, Talent, Performance Partners and functional specialists to turn People initiatives into scalable services, and build dashboards and lightweight analysis that help the team and the business make better decisions. ✅ Requirements Must-Haves You've worked in People Operations, People Services, HR Operations or another operational People role - generalists welcome - and you hold a high bar on accuracy and confidentiality. You've run payroll cycles end to end, ideally multi-country, in-house or through an employer of record. UK fundamentals (PAYE, RTI, pension auto-enrolment, statutory payments) are familiar, or clearly learnable fast if your payroll experience comes from another market. You're highly comfortable with technology: AI is part of how you work, you actively experiment with new tools and capabilities, and you can build automations through no-code or low-code tools, integrations and AI workflows. You think in systems and workflows rather than individual tasks, with a strong instinct for simplification ("why are we doing this manually?"), and you're comfortable using data to diagnose problems and make decisions. You operate effectively in ambiguity, without waiting for a perfectly defined process or remit, and you balance efficiency with empathy - People Operations is about people, not just workflows. Strong ownership instincts: when something's broken, unclear or inefficient, your instinct is to fix it, and you're willing to move across People disciplines depending on where the organisation needs you. Desirable Breadth across the People remit beyond Operations - reward and benchmarking, pensions, benefits, or performance and engagement. This role is deliberately multi-disciplinary. Familiarity with the basics of UK and EU employment law, and experience administering equity or share options (for example EMI or unapproved schemes, and cap-table tools such as Vestd). Experience supporting international employment through employers of record, and setting up or managing contractors (including off-payroll and IR35 awareness). Experience in a fast-scaling startup or scale-up, especially through a period of doubling headcount or entering new countries. 🎁 Benefits & Perks Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. title: Senior Tensor AI Scientist
description: Job Description We are looking for a Senior Scientist to join our Advanced Computing & Modelling team and take a leading role in our research at the intersection of tensor networks and modern machine learning. This is an area of strategic importance for Terra Quantum, with applications across several industries. Your mission is to help grow and strengthen this research and to apply it to demanding real-world problems. We are looking for someone with a broad background in AI and machine learning and strong mathematical foundations, so they can either bring relevant expertise in this area or pick it up and start contributing quickly. The role reports to the Director of Advanced Technologies and works closely with scientists and engineers across the division. Responsibilities Take a leading role in advancing and scaling up our tensor network research, developing new methods for efficient ML model architectures, training, and optimisation, and pushing them beyond the current state of the art. Design and train modern deep learning models, with a focus on making large-scale training more efficient. Develop and improve the algorithms at the core of our methods, taking ideas from concept to validated result. Work with teams across the division to apply these methods to challenging real-world Contribute to patents and selected publications, and represent Terra Quantum at leading conferences. Help structure the team's research and mentor junior colleagues, raising both scientific and engineering standards. Collaborate with engineers across the division to run methods efficiently on modern computing platforms. Qualifications Required Must have more than 5 years of relevant post-PhD experience (or equivalent experience after an MSc) with significant relevant experience in machine learning, applied mathematics, computer science, or a closely related field, with strong mathematical foundations in linear algebra, numerical methods, optimisation, and probability. Hands-on experience training modern deep learning models such as transformers, including efficient large-scale training and fine-tuning, using frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. Strong command of optimisation methods for machine learning, including gradient-based and large-scale optimisation, regularisation, and training dynamics and Experience with efficient training and model compression techniques, such as low-rank methods, quantisation, distillation, or sparsity. A demonstrated ability to master new mathematical frameworks quickly: either existing expertise in this area, or a clear track record showing you can pick it up Strong Python skills and solid software-engineering practice, with experience on GPU and HPC environments and distributed training. A record of publications or patents, and the ability to take a research direction from concept to result independently. Strong communication and organisational skills, and the willingness to guide and develop junior colleagues. Preferred Knowledge of tensor networks and related numerical and optimisation Domain exposure to one or more of: finance, chemistry, or operations Knowledge of C++ and familiarity with quantum computing The Rewards We are an international team of quantum technology experts and dedicated business creatives that are working to bring quantum-enabled solutions to the global market. Our brilliant team members enjoy a high degree of freedom working remotely or joining one of our office spaces. We have a vibrant, enthusiastic, passionate and creative culture driven by trust, excellence and continuous improvement. If you join the Terra Quantum team, you can expect: An opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the pioneering field of Quantum Technologies as well as an experienced and progressive Leadership team Gain knowledge of some of the most cutting-edge technology developments in science & engineering A chance to be part of one of Europe’s leading technology firms of the upcoming decades Welcoming, friendly, and professional colleagues A personal development plan with clear goals for advancement A competitive salary Flexible working arrangements A diverse and supportive atmosphere, where innovation and initiative are encouraged If you are enthusiastic about positively impacting the world and helping to drive the second quantum revolution, let’s talk! Company description Quantum technologies have the potential to solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. There have been great advances in all areas of quantum technologies, and new fields of application are opened up every day. Hybrid computer systems that combine classic high-performance computing with quantum computers are already being used to develop solutions in sectors such as logistics, healthcare, finance, energy, automotive and aerospace. Quantum mechanical predictions are also used to obtain unprecedented precision in measurements, generate unbreakable codes, and form the basis of impenetrable communication networks. All these developments are happening right now, and they are happening at Terra Quantum. At Terra Quantum we are building the world’s leading Quantum Technology company. We offer customers world-class quantum technology expertise organized as “quantum-as-a-service”: hybrid quantum algorithms, quantum compute and quantum enabled security solutions. Through the proprietary quantum cloud, customers have access to a unique technology platform which provides a toolset to solve real-world challenges in the realms of machine learning, optimization and simulation, today. In 2022, the company closed its Series A financing round with a $75m fundraise. Quantum physics has, in some respects, parallels to the machine language of our computers-the zeros and ones into which our keyboard or touchscreen instructions are translated for execution in the computer-only on a larger scale: it is the machine language of the universe. The second quantum revolution is based on the control of individual quantum systems, such as individual atoms. We use quantum computers to solve currently unsolvable problems, simulate molecules and their interactions, find drugs for diseases that are not yet curable, find new materials, or make artificial intelligence stronger. Quantum is now. Terra Quantum is a future-focused quantum services and technology company working on making the second quantum revolution a reality. Terra Quantum’s activities span all areas, markets, and industries globally. Our purpose is to pioneer quantum technologies to change the world for good, Our vision is to lead the quantum revolution and be the trailblazer in technology solutions, shaping a better future for humankind to thrive in, and Our mission is to unleash the power of quantum tech to deliver meaningful solutions today Terra Quantum is an equal opportunities employer, committed to diversity, inclusion and employee well-being.
