title: Senior Information Security Officer
description: Your Role in Our Story: ACT is strengthening its data, technology and AI capabilities as we build a more integrated digital platform alongside our core environmental commodities trading and market-making business. This transformation is commercially driven, enabling us to scale, deepen client relationships and support increasingly complex and digital markets. As Senior Information Security Officer, you will own ACT’s enterprise information security strategy and governance at Group level, spanning our core operations, emerging digital businesses and client-facing technology platforms. You will define the security risk appetite, lead our response to an evolving threat landscape, and ensure security and resilience are embedded by design as our technology landscape develops. Working across business and technology leadership, you will translate commercial ambition into a pragmatic and scalable security posture that protects our systems and data while maintaining the trust of clients, counterparties and regulators. In essence, your role involves: Strategy & Governance Own the Group-wide information security strategy and roadmap across ACT’s core market-making business and digital and client-facing platforms, aligned with business goals and industry frameworks such as ISO 27001 and NIST CSF. Define and maintain ACT’s cyber risk appetite. Establish and lead security governance, including policies, standards and control frameworks, with clear accountability across the Group. Report on security posture and material incidents to executive leadership and, where relevant, the Board. Client Platforms & Secure-by-Design Embed security-by-design into new products and client platforms, partnering with Data, Architecture and Commercial teams to ensure emerging digital capabilities are secure from inception, while acting as a credible security voice to clients and counterparties. Oversee application, product and SaaS security, embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle for internal and client-facing platforms, and assessing third-party services handling ACT and counterparty data. Risk & Resilience Lead enterprise security risk management, including risk assessments, vulnerability management and third-party/supply-chain risk, driving timely mitigation across core and digital environments. Direct incident preparedness and response, coordinating detection, containment, eradication and recovery, while continuously strengthening incident and crisis-management plans. Infrastructure & Emerging Technology Secure ACT’s cloud and infrastructure through Zero-Trust-aligned controls, including identity and access management, segmentation and encryption, across a hybrid and multi-platform environment. Govern emerging technology and AI security, extending security oversight to AI and data platforms, including model and data-exposure risks and AI-enabled threats, as ACT expands its use of AI. Compliance & Leadership Ensure regulatory and compliance alignment, including GDPR, DORA and relevant sector obligations, advising the business on required adaptations and coordinating audits and certifications. Lead the security function and strengthen security culture across the Group, developing the team, raising security awareness, and acting as ACT’s primary authority and trusted advisor on cyber security to executives and business leaders, working alongside existing teams and capabilities. Broad security leadership experience across incident response, cloud and infrastructure security, product/application security and regulatory compliance. Experience securing client-facing platforms or digital products is highly valuable. Experience within trading, financial services, commodities or another data-intensive and regulated environment is highly advantageous. Strong knowledge of security frameworks and standards, including ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and CIS Controls, with practical experience implementing them. Good understanding of data protection, regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, DORA and standards such as SOC 2. Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CISA, or equivalent, are highly desirable. Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex security risks into clear business implications and advise technical teams, executives, business stakeholders and clients. description: We are seeking to expand our Go-To-Market team in RCTT (short for Retail, Consumer, Travel and Transportation) in Europe with a special focus on the Retail sector in the UK&I. Specifically, we are looking for a leader who is experienced with selling and delivering digital transformations encompassing our core offerings of Customer Experience, Product Innovation, Enterprise Platform Modernization, Data Modernization, AI Readiness, Engineering Excellence and Digital Application and Maintenance Operations (DAMO). You will be inheriting one large portfolio in the Retail space based on which you will grow the existing account, and acquire new accounts based on your network, your industry expertise and our marketing activities and in close collaboration with your account team, our industry and service line specialists and the RCTT market organization. As a Client Principals, you are responsible for the entire sales cycle (lead generation through proposal, contract negotiation and closure) as well as client relationship management, account strategy and planning, joint delivery governance and project reviews. This includes e.g. ● Understand the industry context, the customer problem and define mutual value ● Develop and execute on key account plans and overall go-to-market ● Acquire and nurture senior client relationships on strategic accounts ● Achieve established revenue and profitability targets ● Work closely with the account leadership team (consisting e.g. of the account tech director and account delivery director) ● Actively participate in the go-to-market plan creation/refinement for your account as well as for the industry vertical (RCTT), and ● Report account activity, opportunity status and other details to the RCTT leadership (portfolio director) Job responsibilities Establish, build, and maintain long-term, value-based relationships with a growing number of senior client stakeholders. Farm and manage between one and three accounts at a time (including 1-2 prospect accounts). Drive $20 million to $50 million in revenue per year from accounts to meet or exceed profitability targets. Ensure the creation and execution of existing account strategies, and build “win-win” value propositions at the company and individual levels. Help develop a range of IP and best practices around client and portfolio development in order to build the client base into a significant strategic asset. Approach client executives as true business partners versus software delivery partners, expanding the company’s breadth and depth to its full potential. Work on continuous margin improvement in sold and delivered margin. Experience contributing to a clients’ business using a highly consultative and solution-oriented approach. Ability to drive thought leadership and innovation experience for clients. Experience in agile (custom) software development project delivery with the ability to understand the momentum of technical projects and the challenges a highly technical team will face in project execution. title: Data and AI Engineer Director | Market Lead
description: Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI · Director level · London preferred We are looking for a Director-level Market Lead to head our Data & AI practice in the UK & Ireland. This is a hybrid leadership role. You combine deep technical solutioning with real commercial skill, and you are credible both in an architecture debate and across the table from a CDO, CIO or CFO. Our delivery model is shifting from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first pods working against a business outcome. As Market Lead, you will shape how we take that model to UKI clients: what we sell, how we price it, and how we staff and deliver it. You will lead a core team of 5–6 direct reports and a wider matrix of around 50-75 people across UKI, and you will help them build the skills this shift requires. description: Wie ben jij Ben jij een besluitvaardige en energieke professional die met een frisse blik kijkt naar particuliere verzekeringen? Zie jij commerciële kansen voordat anderen ze zien? responsibility A proven track record of generating expansion (upsell/cross-sell) within an enterprise account base Experience in autonomously managing a portfolio of large or multi-entity accounts title: Securities Operations Intern (f/m/d)
description: About Us: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive . Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: In 2027, Upvest is launching the PEA (Plan d'Épargne en Actions) on the French market with several leading fintechs. Within the Settlements & Transfers team, you will work across the full post-trade chain of securities account and PEA transfers: from instruction processing to settlement at Euroclear France, including relations with account keepers, custodians and issuers. This internship offers direct exposure to French and European post-trade operations during a product launch, with real responsibilities from your first weeks. What you’ll do: Incoming and outgoing transfers: Handle securities account (CTO) and PEA transfers with banks and brokers in France and across Europe, from receipt of the request to settlement of securities and cash. Counterparty and client relations: Ensure smooth communication with counterparties (banks, brokers, custodians) and our clients, and drive the follow-up of requests and reminders. Controls and reconciliation: Check securities and cash positions, reconcile movements with our custodian and analyse breaks. Fails and exception management: Investigate unsettled or rejected instructions, identify the root cause and coordinate resolution with counterparties and internal teams. PEA tax continuity: Review and record PEA tax statements (bordereaux d'information) to ensure the plan's tax history is fully preserved. Registered shares: Process operations on French registered shares (conversions, de/registrations). description: Virtusan is a Swiss based health coaching platform for sleep, stress and recovery that works with any wearable, including our own smart ring. You’ll be the technical authority for AI across engineering; you make the calls on architecture and approach, set the standards others build to and stay hand-on in the code. Hands on: This is a builder role. You’ll be prototyping, evaluating and taking code through to production. Requirements 6+ years in ML/AI engineering incl. 2+ years in a lead role, with at least one product taken from zero to production Python, FastAPI and production MLOps on Azure or another major cloud Time series, recommender systems, causal/uplift methods and strong statistics A/B testing, model evaluation and production monitoring LLMs and LangGraph (or similar) on Azure OpenAI, and knowing when not to use them Experience as a tech lead or staff engineer, making technical decisions that a team of engineers followed. Privacy-aware handling of health data Based in Europe and fluent in English Nice to have: bandits, RL or off-policy evaluation; health or wearable data; literature mining; AI in engineering workflows (coding agents, AI-assisted testing, CI). title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Per markt, regio, entiteit, businessunit en klantsegment analyseer je waar kansen liggen, op basis van verwachte klantwaarde, omzetpotentieel, kosten, marge, cashflow, risico en schaalbaarheid. Deze inzichten verwerk je in businesscases waarin zowel het perspectief van de klant als van Voortman Steel Machinery naar voren komen. Daarnaast ontwikkel je heldere investeringskaders en breng je passende financieringsmodellen in kaart die aansluiten op de aard van de activiteiten en de internationale context. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Met heldere go/no-go-momenten per fase zorg je ervoor dat de ontwikkeling en implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen niet sneller gaat dan wat de organisatie kan adopteren. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. Zo werk je gericht aan verdien- en prijsmodellen die commercieel aantrekkelijk, financieel gezond en schaalbaar zijn. Als CFO draag je actief bij aan de verdere internationale groei van Voortman Steel Machinery. Hiervoor ontwikkel je strategische, financiële en organisatorische plannen, zodat per markt en internationale entiteit helder is welke inrichting het beste past bij de gewenste groei. Daarbij verzorg je de afstemming tussen verschillende afdelingen en entiteiten, zonder de lijnverantwoordelijkheid van collega's over te nemen. Jij fungeert als sparringpartner, stuurt bij waar nodig, bewaakt de strategisch richting van de Finance-afdeling, verzorgt correcte governance en behandeld onderwerpen met board impact. Tevens ben je het gezicht van Voortman Steel Machinery richting banken, verzekeraars, accountant en andere financiële stakeholders. Wat maakt deze rol uniek? title: Engineering Manager, Experiment Platform, Robot Software
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. Within it, the Experiment Platform team owns the systems that let our researchers develop driving models on the road: deploying models to vehicles, running experiments, and collecting the data that trains the next model. The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. It is used across our own fleet and on pre-production vehicles with OEM partners in Europe and Japan, and is central to how Wayve adapts its AI Driver to new vehicles. You will lead a team of engineers based in London, working alongside the Runtime Platform, OS, Sensors and Platform Integration teams in Robot Software. 🧠 Your day-to-day You will lead the team’s people, plans and partnerships. Most of your time goes to your engineers: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, performance and promotion cycles, and helping technical leads take on more scope. You will work with your tech leads on technical decisions, own the outcomes, and make sure the team responds well when issues come up in the field. You will maintain the team’s mission, charter and twelve-month roadmap, turn them into quarterly and six-week plans, and keep delivery on track. You will be the team’s main point of contact for partner engineering teams, programme managers, operations and OEM customers, and you will make it clear what the team owns. You will stay technically capable and aware of the team’s work across the codebase. You will monitor the architecture, guide the team through technical blockers when needed, and engage with technical leaders in other teams at a technical level. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Growing the platform: Take the development platform from its first stable release to a product used across many vehicle types, with predictable releases and validation in CI and on HIL benches. Experiment control and fleet orchestration: Own model and controller download, the robot state machine, and over-the-air deployment of software, configuration and calibration. Self-serve experimentation: Make the platform self-serve, so research teams can run their own experiments on vehicles without waiting for platform changes. Scaling data collection: Onboard and event-based logging, data quality, and data offload over New vehicles and OEM integrations: Deploy the full platform on Wayve’s next-generation vehicles, and support new OEM integrations through configuration rather than new releases. Building the operating model around the platform: Releases, support rota, on-call, metrics and observability. Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, and grow the team as adoption of the platform expands. 🙌 You should apply if: You have managed software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching and performance management. You have owned a platform or product that other teams or customers relied on, and shipped it to devices in the field. You are technically capable, with hands-on experience in embedded Linux systems software (C++ or Python), and stay close enough to the code to review your team’s work, guide architecture and help resolve technical blockers. You understand connected device fleets, such as vehicles, robots or IoT, including data logging and offload, over-the-air updates and observability. You are comfortable leading delivery across many stakeholders, including external partners, and can engage with other technical leaders as a technical peer. You care about operational reliability and release quality. Experience with autonomous vehicles or robotics, automotive ECUs (for example NVIDIA Jetson or DRIVE, QNX), Yocto, IPC middleware such as ROS 2 or DDS, or containerised workloads on embedded systems is desirable. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. This role is based in our London office. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews : leadership and management interview, and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total Deep-dive interviews : domain, systems design and code review interviews; 3 hours total Final interview : values alignment (30-45 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. That work will be delivered by several external squads brought in for the program. Stand up and onboard external squads, around 20 developers across 5 to 6 squads, on time : access, environments, documentation, and a well-scoped first backlog ready before they start Track the delivery pace of each squad against its commitments, and keep a clear program-level view of what’s on track, slipping, or blocked Hold squads to the quality bar set by the architectural board : tests, reviews, and no new debt introduced while removing old debt Manage cross-squad dependencies so work lands in the right order Track program spend against budget and manage the relationships with the partners supplying the squads Report program status to the CTO and the board on a regular cadence Part two : become the operational backbone of engineering. title: Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager
description: WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. For more information, visit WPP.com. About WPP WPP is the creative transformation company. Through One WPP and the Elevate28 transformation agenda, we are building a simpler, more integrated, agile and AI-powered enterprise. WPP’s Performance & Culture Center of Excellence brings together the capabilities that help our people, teams and organisation perform, grow and thrive. Within it, Enterprise Effectiveness aligns WPP’s organisation, workforce and teams around its strategic priorities and enables the change required to deliver them. About the Role The Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager is a contract role that will build the evidence base for the workforce and organisation decisions that matter most to WPP. This role will turn fragmented people, organisation and business data into clear insight, forward-looking scenarios and practical recommendations that help leaders decide where to invest, how to shape the workforce and how to organise for performance. Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, you will support the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence while working closely with business, People & Culture, Finance, Data and Technology partners. You will establish a trusted workforce-intelligence capability that supports strategic workforce planning and informs priority organisation, workforce, team and people decisions across Enterprise Effectiveness and the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence. This is not a traditional reporting role. It combines strategic analytics, internal consulting and leadership of a four-person data and reporting team based in India. You will be expected to work through ambiguity, connect disparate data and systems, and progressively turn fragmented analytics into a more integrated, trusted and usable capability. As a contract appointment, the initial focus will be to establish the core workforce-intelligence approach, strengthen the India-based team and deliver insight against WPP’s highest-priority workforce and organisation questions. Why This Role Matters WPP’s transformation requires faster, better choices about work, skills, capacity, organisation and investment. Those choices cannot be made from disconnected dashboards or backward-looking metrics alone. In this role, you will create a more integrated view of the workforce, translate evidence into choices and trade-offs, and help leaders anticipate the implications of AI, changing client demand and new ways of working. The work will directly shape how WPP builds the capabilities, capacity and organisation required for Elevate28. What You’ll Do Build a trusted workforce intelligence capability Working with the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, shape and build an enterprise workforce-intelligence approach that connects people, organisation and business data to the decisions leaders need to make. Define a focused set of workforce and organisational measures, dashboards and decision-support tools, moving reporting from activity and headcount toward capacity, capability, cost, productivity, risk and value. Partner with data owners and technology teams to map fragmented data and systems, define analytical requirements, and strengthen data definitions, quality, accessibility and responsible use, while being clear about limitations and the strength of the evidence. Establish repeatable analytical standards, governance and quality controls so insight is trusted, comparable and usable across WPP. Apply AI and automation to improve how workforce data is integrated, analysed and translated into decision support, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, transparency and responsible-use standards. Enable strategic workforce planning Help business and People & Culture leaders translate strategy, growth priorities and choices about how work is organised into workforce demand, capability and capacity requirements. Build scenarios that show the implications of different choices, including developing, hiring, accessing external capability, automating, augmenting, redeploying and exiting work or roles. Assess the current workforce and future talent supply, including critical skills, capacity, cost, location and role mix, highlighting gaps, risks and investment priorities. Connect workforce planning to business and financial planning cycles so decisions are timely, owned and grounded in common assumptions. Deliver forward-looking insight and decision support Use statistical analysis, forecasting and scenario modelling to identify emerging workforce and organisational risks, opportunities and patterns. Bring structure to ambiguous business questions, identify what can be answered with available data, test hypotheses and distinguish meaningful signals from correlation or noise. Turn analysis into clear choices, trade-offs and recommendations for senior leaders, including the consequences of action and inaction. Develop concise executive narratives and visualisations that make complex findings understandable without oversimplifying them. Strengthen organisation and transformation decisions Provide analytical support for organisation design, organisational health, inclusion and impact, talent development, team effectiveness and change priorities across Performance and Culture. Create baselines and evaluate whether organisation and workforce interventions are improving the intended outcomes. Combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight to explain not only what is happening, but why it matters and where targeted action is needed. Identify enterprise patterns across businesses, markets and functions and convert them into practical recommendations for leaders and Enterprise Effectiveness partners. Scale tools, capability and adoption Build practical tools, templates and self-service products that improve the quality and consistency of workforce decisions. Coach People & Culture and business partners to interpret workforce insight, challenge assumptions and use scenarios in decision-making. Create a clear intake and prioritisation approach that focuses analytical capacity on the highest-value enterprise questions. Continuously improve the offer through user feedback, adoption evidence and emerging practice in workforce analytics, AI and organisational science. Lead and develop a four-person data and reporting team based in India, setting clear priorities, strengthening analytical and consulting capability, and shifting delivery from fragmented reporting toward higher-value workforce intelligence and decision support. Minimum Qualifications Relevant experience applying data and analytics in finance, commercial, operational or other business settings, together with experience in people analytics, workforce intelligence or strategic workforce planning. Experience translating business questions into analytical approaches, workforce scenarios and decision-ready recommendations. Strong capability in data analysis, forecasting, modelling and visualisation, using appropriate business intelligence or analytical tools. Proven experience working through ambiguity and improving a fragmented data and analytics environment by connecting disparate sources

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description: Who we are Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility. We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education. We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards. Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions! About this role We are looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to turn Yubo's brand ambition into brilliant, effective marketing, from major campaign moments to paid and owned-channel activity, and the smaller tests that help us learn what works. Reporting to the Director of Brand & Communications, you will translate Yubo's brand strategy into an executable US marketing programme. You will lead integrated brand campaigns, own campaign and paid-media planning and management, and build and manage influencer capabilities. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who can move comfortably between strategic thinking and execution. You will challenge plans constructively, make recommendations grounded in insight and data, and work closely with Creative, PR, Product, UA, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal to deliver marketing that builds the brand and drives growth. The role will focus on the US first, with scope to contribute to expansion into new markets as Yubo's marketing activity grows. This is a freelance position on a 6-month contract, with a target start of Q4 2026. Your responsibilites Turn strategic priorities into impactful marketing activity Lead the development and execution of Yubo's priority brand campaigns in the US, from insight and strategy through briefing, delivery, optimisation and reporting. Translate Yubo's positioning, audience priorities and seasonal moments into cultural marketing activity that earns attention amongst Gen Z. Develop integrated channel plans across paid, earned and owned activity, working closely with PR and Creative to ensure every channel plays a clear role. Own campaign budget planning and day-to-day management, partnering closely with UA on paid-media strategy and optimisation. Explore new, less traditional ways for Yubo to reach and engage people, challenging default channel choices and designing approaches that make marketing work harder. Establish brand marketing operations and measurement Establish effective working rhythms across Brand, Creative, PR, Product, UA and Data, from briefing and approvals to reporting and learning. Work closely with Data and UA to analyse performance and make clear, evidence-based optimisation recommendations. Build clear measurement plans so every campaign, test and experiment informs future investment and potential expansion into new markets. Identify, recommend and deliver smaller tests and experiments that help Yubo learn quickly and improve future investment. Build influencer, social and community activity Build the plans, operating models and internal capability needed to deliver consistently strong influencer activity and integrate it into wider campaign plans. Manage influencer agency relationships, negotiating cost-effective partnership models that maximise impact and effectiveness. Who you are You are an experienced brand marketer with strong consumer instincts and a genuine interest in youth culture. You know how to turn a positioning and a business objective into a campaign people notice, and how to turn campaign results into smarter decisions next time. You are as comfortable building a strategic recommendation as you are writing a brief, reviewing creative, shaping a media plan, interrogating performance data or getting into the practical detail needed to make work happen. You don't wait for perfect information or a fully formed process; you create clarity, bring people together and move work forward. You will bring: A breadth of experience in brand and integrated marketing, ideally in a high-growth tech, consumer app, entertainment, lifestyle or youth-culture business. A track record of developing and delivering integrated campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels, working closely with cross-functional partners. An understanding of the US market and how 18–24-year-olds engage with brands, culture and social platforms. Experience owning campaign and paid-media planning and management, ideally in close partnership with performance marketing, creative and comms teams. Confidence analysing campaign performance and translating data into clear optimisation and investment recommendations. Experience working closely with creative teams to develop strong campaign platforms, briefs and work that is both strategically sharp and creatively ambitious. A curiosity for less traditional channels, partnerships and approaches, with the creativity to test new ways of reaching people and maximise earned attention above what we buy. A proactive, autonomous and highly collaborative working style. Within a month, you will Get up to speed on Yubo's brand, product, US market and audience. Meet your key stakeholders across Brand, Creative, PR, Product, UA and Data. Review current campaign activity, budgets and ways of working. Start shaping the US marketing calendar and briefs with the Director of Brand & Communications. Within 3 months, you will Be leading delivery of Yubo's US campaigns, with briefs, channel plans and budgets in place. Have established the operating model between Brand, UA, Creative, PR, Product and Data. Be building the campaign measurement framework. Have started shaping Yubo's influencer marketing approach, including early agency conversations. Within 6 months, you will Have delivered Yubo's priority US brand campaigns end to end, from strategy through reporting. Have embedded the cross-functional operating model and measurement framework. Have established influencer marketing at Yubo, with agency partnerships operating. Have delivered key tests and experiments, with recommendations to inform 2027 priorities. The recruitment process First call with Nicolas, Talent Acquisition A technical test with Alex, our Brand Director Our approach to privacy & safety As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts. Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact. Here’s how we live our mission every day: Y ou own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter U nconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better B e Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward O ne team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you. Enjoy Top-notch Benefits Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits: Cool Workplace : enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options Team Activities : participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities Family-Friendly : we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly poli

title: (Senior) Programmatic Sales GSA
description: YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want. Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one. That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do. THE ROLE As a Programmatic Sales GSA, you will be responsible for the automated and data-driven sale of our digital advertising inventory (primarily video and CTV) and report directly to the Director Sales All Markets. You will manage programmatic bookings, oversee the planning, implementation and optimisation of our initiatives to boost revenue in programmatic sales, and will therefore also be directly responsible for the optimisation and smooth, technical implementation of campaigns. This makes you the primary point of contact for agency trading desks in the GSA region regarding preferred deals and PMP strategies. You’ll also help with SSP and header bidding integrations and act as the link between Sales, Tech and AdOps. THE ADS TEAM The Ads Team is a small but highly efficient team that combines technology and marketing to win customers over in the long term. With a presence in two countries (based in Berlin, Hamburg and Zurich) and operations in six countries, the Ads Team is a key driver of growth within Zattoo and has established itself as the market leader in CTV in Switzerland within a year. WHAT YOU’LL DO Acquisition of new customers, advice, support and guide media agencies, trading desks and direct clients through our programmatic possibilities in a way they can understand. Drawing up and negotiating bespoke programme packages, private deals or preferred deals. Maximise inventory revenue, skilfully manage floor prices (minimum prices) and analyse delivery rates and CPMs. Partner with regional sales teams in GSA to consult clients and pitch programmatic solutions. Co-lead the technical and commercial setup of Header Bidding and additional SSP integrations for CTV. First-line technical ownership of programmatic delivery. Identify technical errors during delivery, analyse tracking issues and check campaign set-ups: troubleshoot deal delivery, floor pricing, and DSP configuration issues (e.g., SSAI, VAST responses, pod management, DSP/SSP bid stream mismatches). Explain complex technical matters in simple terms to non-technical customers or internal departments. WHAT YOU’LL BRING 4+ years of experience in Programmatic Advertising, SSP Management, or Programmatic Account Management (strong experience in CTV/Video) A proven track record in the sales of digital advertising products Deep understanding of Google Ad Manager, DSP/SSP workflows, OpenRTB specs, and deal types (Preferred Deals, PMP, PG) Experience or strong technical familiarity with Header Bidding frameworks (e.g., Prebid) and SSP integrations Strong network or understanding of the DACH Agency Trading Desk landscape Fluent in German and English Independent, strong communicator, able to work under pressure, with strong negotiation skills Teamplayer and creative thinker with a questioning mindset. WHY JOIN US? At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all. WHAT WE OFFER YOU Reward : strong market competitive salary Recharge : 30 days vacation plus public holidays Regulate : trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year Plus: We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days We’re inclusive: ‘ Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more! We’re responsible: We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV. We are committed to ensuring fair, open, and equitable hiring practices and are happy to answer any questions you may have about us or the role throughout the whole process. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we share the applicable compensation range with you before your first interview. In short, someone who likes: Unlocking Visual Data: Building pipelines that can "read" complex documents, understanding layout, charts, and visual context using Vision-Language Models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5) and Layout Analysis . Orchestrating Intelligence: Owning the application logic layer. You will use LangChain or LangGraph to build the agents and chains that query our data, reason about it, and generate responses. Native PDF Handling: Handling the messy reality of PDF processing (PyMuPDF, layout parsing) to preserve structure before the AI even sees it. Prompt Engineering & Logic: Crafting complex prompts and control flows to ensure models interpret financial charts and layouts accurately without hallucinating. Cost & Scale: Applying a cost-optimization mindset (batch processing, model selection) to ensure our vision and orchestration layers are economically viable. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps. Ideally, they would also have: LLM Orchestration (Must Have ): Deep experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks. You know how to manage context windows, tool calling, and agentic workflows. Multimodal AI Experience: Hands-on experience integrating state-of-the-art vision models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) and embedding models (CLIP). Document Intelligence Specialist: Familiarity with specialized models (e.g., Donut, Pix2Struct) and tools like Unstructured.io or Docling. PDF Processing Mastery: Mastery over tools like PyMuPDF or pdfplumber for native element extraction. Python ML Stack: Strong proficiency in PyTorch or TensorFlow. Nice-to-Have: Fine-Tuning: Experience fine-tuning vision or language models, specifically to improve accuracy on domain-specific artifacts like financial charts or tables. Domain Knowledge: Prior experience handling documents in the Real Estate or Finance sectors. Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. title: Principal Product Strategist, AI Engagement Leader

Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together. About the Role at Able Able is an AI-native product engineering firm. We partner with organizations that need to move faster, use AI more effectively, and build products that reflect how their teams and customers actually work. title: Enterprise Account Executive, New Business Development
description: Enterprise Account Executive, New Business Development Affiliate Marketing / MarTech — Acceleration Partners LOCATION This is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners, a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Applicants can be based in the US, UK, Germany. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a hunter to drive new client acquisition for our Affiliate Marketing & Influencer Services. This is a new business development role built for someone who thrives on opening doors: sourcing opportunities, building relationships with enterprise decision-makers, and running a deal from first contact through close. Our marketing team generates inbound leads and our sales support team provides collateral and financial modeling, but the right candidate won't wait for leads to come to them. This role is built around a team-based selling model. You bring the opportunity in the door, qualify it, and manage the relationship and the process; our strategy and account management teams build the narrative, the strategic recommendation, and lead the pitch delivery. You're the connective tissue between the prospect and our experts, and the role suits driven, relationship-first sellers who want to sell alongside a strong internal team rather than carry the full strategic load alone. TOP 5 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES New Business Development: Proactively source and build your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, industry relationships, and strategic networking, in addition to working inbound leads. You are a hunter first, and pipeline generation is the core measure of this role. Deal Management & Sales Process Ownership: Own large, complex deals ($500K+ annual contract value) from first contact through close, managing the timeline and multiple decision-makers across marketing, ecommerce, finance, and executive leadership. Discovery & Qualification: Ask the right questions to understand each prospect's business, priorities, and buying process well enough to qualify the opportunity and brief our strategy team. Orchestrating the Pitch: Bring in our strategy and account management teams at the right points in the sales cycle to build and deliver the narrative, the strategic recommendation, and the RFP response. Your job is to set the stage, make introductions, prep the room, and coordinate the team so the pitch lands. Pipeline Discipline & Market Awareness: Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting, and stay current on the Affiliate & Influencer Marketing space well enough to prospect credibly and know when to loop in strategy. WHAT YOU BRING Enterprise Sales Experience Demonstrated track record of closing large enterprise deals, $500K+ in annual contract value Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across marketing, ecommerce, and executive functions, without needing to own the strategic pitch personally Experience selling into marketing or ecommerce departments at large enterprise companies; experience selling into large retailers is a strong plus Hunter Mentality Proven ability to source your own opportunities through outbound prospecting: cold outreach, industry events, LinkedIn, and relationship-based selling Self-starter who doesn't rely solely on inbound leads, and is resilient and persistent about opening new doors Digital Marketing Working Knowledge General familiarity with the digital marketing space, enough to prospect credibly and hold an intelligent first conversation; deep strategic expertise isn't required, since that lives with our strategy and account management teams Affiliate / Influencer marketing knowledge is a plus, not a requirement Technical & Tools Proficiency Salesforce, required; HubSpot an advantage AI fluency, including using AI tools to work smarter in prospecting, research, and pipeline management Proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint Collaborative, Team-Based Selling Genuine comfort handing off the strategic narrative to internal experts, and strong ability to coordinate across strategy, account management, and delivery teams in a fully remote environment Skilled at reading a room well enough to know when to bring in an expert, and disciplined enough to prep that expert properly beforehand MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 5+ years of digital marketing or marketing services sales experience Demonstrated experience closing enterprise deals of $500K+ ACV Experience selling into marketing and/or ecommerce departments at large enterprise or retail brands Proven track record of outbound pipeline generation Salesforce required; HubSpot an advantage A genuine interest in AI tools, including hands-on experience integrating AI into your work Must be based in the US, UK, Germany. Ability to travel when and where required WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE By 3 Months… You're fully up to speed on Acceleration Partners' value proposition, services, and sales process, and on how the handoff to strategy and account management works. You've built an active outbound pipeline, are engaging multiple enterprise prospects, and know when and how to bring in the strategy team. By 1 Year… You've closed multiple enterprise deals. Prospects consistently move smoothly from your first conversation into a strong strategy pitch, and the strategy and account management teams see you as a reliable partner who sets them up to win. WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS? Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing. AP PERKS & BENEFITS — WHAT WE OFFER 100% remote work for everyone Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) 401K with matching / Pension contributions Open Paid Time Off Paid Parental Leave Benefits Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances Target base salary is $90-120K, with competitive, uncapped commission structure, based on location and experience Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location. Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. #LI-REMOTE *GLSDR #LI-MG1

title: Lead Solutions Engineer
description: Job Description - Lead Solutions Engineer The Lead Solutions Engineer is a technical expert and trusted advisor driving Acquia’s growth across the Japan market. Operating at the intersection of business strategy and technical architecture, this role is primarily focused on winning new-logo business, while also driving cross-sell and expansion across the Acquia Digital Experience Platform (DXP) portfolio. Working hand-in-hand with Account Executives and, critically, Acquia’s partner ecosystem — through which nearly all new business in Japan is sourced — the Lead Solutions Engineer turns customer challenges into compelling solutions that deliver demonstrable business value and substantial revenue growth. Key Responsibilities Strategic Account Growth & Cross-Sell New Logo Acquisition: Be the technical lead partnering with Account Executives and channel / SI partners to identify, qualify, and win new-logo opportunities across Japan — the primary focus of the role. Cross-Sell & Expansion: Identify and accelerate cross-sell and expansion opportunities within strategic accounts where Solutions Engineering support adds value, mapping Acquia’s DXP portfolio to each client’s future-state digital roadmap. Business Value Alignment: Drive a value-based approach by translating solutions into clear, quantifiable business outcomes and return on investment for both technical and business stakeholders. Trusted Technical Advisor: Serve as the technical contact for client stakeholders, providing guidance on digital strategy, cloud adoption, and DXP trends across their technical and business teams. Solutions Architecture & Governance Technical Discovery: Lead the technical discovery, design, and presentation of DXP solutions tailored to each customer’s context and business priorities. Custom Proofs: Design and execute impactful custom demonstrations and Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) that clearly illustrate the business value of the Acquia platform. Competitive Positioning: Position Acquia against key competitors through strong discovery and a clear point of view on fit, reinforcing Acquia’s unique value. Partner Enablement & Market Presence Partner Enablement: Enable partners at the pre-sales layer — coaching their teams to position and present Acquia products confidently in their own pitches, both one-to-one and at events. Market Presence: Represent Acquia at industry events, webinars, and community gatherings, proactively creating opportunities and visibility across the Japan market. Product Feedback Loop: Serve as a feedback loop to Acquia’s Product and Engineering teams, synthesizing insights from the Japan market to help shape positioning and priorities. Skills and Qualifications Required Experience: Proven experience in a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or pre-sales role, or a strong, deeply technical Account Executive ready to operate in a Solutions Engineering capacity. What matters most is the ability to understand a customer’s business and translate it into the right solution. DXP Expertise: Experience selling or pre-selling an enterprise CMS / DXP, or a comparable SaaS platform — vendor-agnostic. Strong understanding of CMS, personalization, and modern digital experience concepts (Drupal a plus, not a requirement). Technical Foundation: Solid working knowledge of modern web architectures and how DXP / web applications are deployed on a major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including APIs and security fundamentals. Partner & Channel: Proven ability to work with and through partners / channel to source and win business — central to this role, as nearly all new-logo ACV in Japan is partner-sourced. Communication: Strong presentation and demonstration skills, with the ability to lead both the technical and the business conversation with customers and partners. Language: Native-level Japanese and business-level English — leading customer and partner discussions in Japanese (including written RFP / PoC work) and collaborating with a UK / EMEA-based team in English. Ways of Working: A self-starter who works with autonomy as the dedicated Solutions Engineering presence for the region, acting on sound judgment while maintaining strong visibility with manager and team, and with a genuine appetite for continuous learning. Desired (Extra Credit) Proven track record of success working within a named global or strategic account program. Experience with a major programming language and hands-on ability to build technical prototypes. Published articles, white papers, or presentation experience at major industry conferences. Acquia DNA & Culture This is a remote, Japan-focused role for a self-starter who thrives on high-impact work and enjoys operating with autonomy. The ability to work across time zones with a collaborative, virtual team is essential. Occasional travel within Japan to engage customers and partners is expected; coverage beyond Japan is possible as an upside but is not a requirement.

title: Strategic Alliance Director

We're experiencing exponential growth and expanding our go-to-market engine through strategic partnerships. We're seeking a Strategic Alliance Director to build and scale 6-8 NA consulting/SI partners as a primary revenue engine. The remaining 30% focuses on partner enablement, solution co-creation, GTM strategy, and ecosystem management. What You'll Do • Identify, qualify, and onboard 6-8 strategic NA partners (Deloitte, Accenture, EY, KPMG, Slalom, etc.); establish governance with monthly reviews, quarterly QBRs, and clear success criteria • Co-develop partner business plans with pipeline targets and regional account lists; create and maintain partner resource portal • Build partner-specific GTM strategies and vertical focus; co-create solutions and execute joint campaigns (webinars, case studies, co-marketing) • Partner with NA Sales Leader on territory mapping, regional alignment, and quarterly regional business reviews • Gather competitive intelligence from Snowflake and Databricks partners; share win/loss insights with Actian sales and product What Success Looks Like (Year 1) • 6-8 partners onboarded with business plans and SLAs • $3M-5M+ partner-sourced pipeline; 40-50+ joint customer meetings; 20-30% deal conversion; 90%+ deal registration compliance • 70%+ partner certification rate; 2-3 co-created solutions; 3+ joint GTM campaigns launched • Zero territory conflicts; 80%+ of sales reps actively pursuing partner pipeline • Competitive intelligence relationships established; quarterly briefings to leadership Our Ideal Strategic Alliance Director Will Have • 7+ years in strategic alliance management, partner business development, or SI/consulting channel sales • Proven success building and scaling 5+ key partner relationships with Deloitte, Accenture, EY, KPMG, Slalom, or similar firms • Direct experience managing partner-originated pipeline, customer meetings, deal conversion, and partner business plans • Demonstrated success designing and executing partner enablement programs and GTM strategies • Field sales or channel experience; MBA preferred • Revenue accountability mindset – quota-driven with personal accountability for pipeline • Partner business planning and enablement program design expertise • GTM strategy, negotiation skills, and strong executive communication • Strategic business acumen; understand partner economics and co-selling models • Excellent sales collaboration – you enable reps without complicating their world • High initiative and self-directed relationship builder with a sales edge 30%+ travel: partner offices, customer sites, Actian sales offices. Based in major NA markets (SF, NYC, Chicago Colorado, Texas, preferred). Why Actian • Direct revenue impact – 70% quota tied to partner-sourced pipeline • Build the channel; shape partner strategy and GTM at a critical inflection point with all the resources needed from technical to marketing • Work with elite partners – Deloitte, Accenture, Slalom, and other top-tier SI firms, plus Snowflake, Databricks • Field-forward culture – 30%+ time with partners, sales teams, and customers • Sales enablement role – you're a force multiplier for NA Sales Leader and regional reps • Hyper-growth opportunity in mission-critical data infrastructure Compensation Additional Information

title: Director of Product Marketing
description: AI is fundamentally changing how product strategy and market strategy work together. The boundary between building the right product and bringing it to market the right way is disappearing — and the companies that recognize this will build product marketing functions that operate as strategic growth engines, not service organizations. ActiveCampaign ’s Active Intelligence platform — autonomous AI agents serving 180,000+ growing businesses — is redefining how marketing works. We need a Director of Product Marketing who shapes how the market understands it through bold storytelling, drives adoption that compounds, and transforms the PMM discipline in the process. This role reports to the SVP of Product. Product and Product Marketing operate as a single strategic arm — you’ll have the same context as the people building the product and the same accountability for what happens when it meets the market. This is a player-coach role: you lead a team, but you also personally create — strategies, narratives, content, programs. AI makes that possible at a level it never was before, and we expect our leaders to use it. Why This Role Matters: The way companies build, market, and grow products is being reshaped by AI. Product Marketing must evolve from a support function into a strategic operating system for customer understanding, market differentiation, and intelligent go-to-market execution. At ActiveCampaign, we’re building that now. This role is at the center of it. On a typical day, you might: Market Narrative & Positioning: Define and evolve positioning that clearly articulates why Active Intelligence represents a fundamentally new way for businesses to run their marketing — and why that matters now. Translate complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling customer value that resonates across segments. Bring conviction to the narrative — if the story isn't bold enough, make it bolder. We want a PMM leader whose point of view strengthens every room they're in. Adoption & Customer Outcomes: Lead go-to-market strategies measured by adoption and continued usage, not launch ceremony. Your success is customers who build their business on Active Intelligence. Own the market-side of the customer lifecycle — the narrative that moves someone from “I tried it” to “I can’t turn this off.” Partner with Product to build both sides of that engine. Run experimentation-driven programs: every initiative has a hypothesis, a signal, and a learning cycle. We move in weekly learning cycles, not quarterly planning windows. AI-First Execution: Automate traditional launch mechanics — release notes, enablement decks, internal comms. Your team operates above the automation line. Leverage AI to transform how the PMM craft works, not just what it produces. Speed, experimentation, and operational scale improve by default. Sales, Partner & Revenue Enablement: Arm Sales, CS, and our partner ecosystem with positioning, proof points, and talk tracks that improve conversations and conversion. Establish feedback loops between GTM teams and Product — friction points and market opportunities flow back into product decisions. Evangelism & Market Authority: Build the market presence that makes ActiveCampaign the reference point for autonomous marketing — thought leadership, proof points, and narrative formats that establish our position. Team Leadership: Lead a PMM team of outcome owners who own strategic priorities the way PMs own product areas — with backlogs, experiments, and shipped impact. Set the standard by doing the work yourself, not just directing it. The best PMM leaders we’ve seen create alongside their teams — AI makes that leverage real. Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and urgency. Create clarity in ambiguity and drive alignment through influence and results. Invest in your people's growth as seriously as the work itself — create conditions where they do the best work of their careers in service to their individual and collective success. The ideal candidate will bring: Required: 8+ years of hands-on experience in Product Marketing, Growth, or Product Strategy in B2B SaaS or AI-driven technology companies. 3+ years of proven leadership experience leading PMM teams — experience building or transforming a function, not just running one. A product-strategy mindset: you think about market impact the way great PMs think about product-market fit. A proven track record driving adoption and retention outcomes, not just launch metrics. Proven ability to influence across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Highly Valued: Prior experience with AI-native products , marketing automation, or platform products serving SMB/mid-market Experience building experimentation-driven marketing functions. Deep customer empathy paired with analytical rigor. A mindset that thinks beyond launches — you understand how product marketing drives company growth. A desire to erase the artificial boundary between product and marketing. An AI-native approach in how you think, work, and lead — not just AI-curious. A bias for action and execution: you’d rather build the positioning doc yourself than wait for someone to draft it. Leading a team doesn’t mean you stop creating. The ability to build trust through clarity, accountability, and results. You care about outcomes, not organizational theater. A passion for transformation rather than maintenance. What Success Looks Like: Within 3–6 months, you will have: Established Product Marketing as a strategic growth function trusted by Product, GTM, and leadership. Driven measurable improvement in product adoption, continued usage, and customer expansion. Sharpened market and product positioning to the point where customers deeply understand the step-change innovation we’re delivering and how it transforms their business. Built a modern PMM operating model — a team of leaders fully leveraging AI in everything they do, oriented around measurable business outcomes. One more thing Please review the prompt below and come prepared to discuss it during the interview: Tell us about a time you drove product adoption through experimentation rather than a traditional launch playbook. What was the hypothesis? What did you learn? What would you do differently? We value this response highly — it tells us more about how you think than any resume line. title: Customer Solutions Consultant, Ada Accelerate
description: About Us Ada is an AI customer service company whose mission is to make customer service extraordinary for everyone. We're driven to raise a new standard of quality customer service at scale, enabling enterprise companies to deliver experiences that people love–instant, proactive, personalized, and effortless. Ada is an AI transformation platform and partner—combining strategic expertise with powerful AI agent management technology to accelerate businesses’ AI maturity to keep them ahead of the curve. With Ada, 83% of customer conversations—and counting—are effortlessly resolved through automation, giving teams more time back, companies more resources to focus on growth, and customers more life to focus on what matters most to them. Established in 2016, Ada is a Canadian company that has powered over 5.5 billion interactions for leading brands like Square, YETI, IPSY, and Monday.com , saving millions of hours of human effort. Backed with over $250M in funding from tier-one investors including Accel, Bessemer, FirstMark, Spark, and Version One Ventures, Ada is a pioneer in the management and application of AI in customer service. At Ada, we see growth as a reflection of each individual owner’s personal growth. That’s why our values are rooted in driving progress and continuous improvement. As a Customer Solutions Consultant you will: Provide customer success and support to Ada’s SMB and MME customers through resolving customer inquiries, advising with AI expertise, and ensuring optimal value realization of the platform. title: Infrastructure Engineer
description: This role is open for LATAM based candidates About us: Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive. The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals. Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market. As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies. About the Role We're looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and maintain our cloud infrastructure and platform systems. You'll work closely with development teams to create scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure that powers our products. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Designs, implements, and manages AWS cloud infrastructure, including VPCs, EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, Lambda, and other foundational services. Develops and maintains Terraform modules to provision and manage infrastructure in a repeatable, version-controlled manner. Deploys, manages, and optimizes Kubernetes clusters (EKS), handling workload orchestration, autoscaling, and resource management. Builds and improves continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to enable fast, safe, and automated releases. Implements logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions to ensure system health and enable rapid incident response. Applies strict infrastructure security best practices, manages secrets, and ensures compliance with internal security policies. Writes scripts and tools to automate operational tasks, reducing manual toil and improving the overall developer experience. Creates and maintains runbooks, architecture diagrams, and technical documentation. Partners with development teams to improve platform reliability and streamline application deployments. Participates in an on-call rotation schedule to respond to production incidents and ensure continuous system reliability. Designs and provisions cloud infrastructure specifically tailored to support scalable AI/LLM workloads and agentic systems, ensuring optimized compute resource allocation and high availability. Evaluates and integrates AI-driven DevOps tools and LLM-assisted automations into the platform workflow to accelerate incident response, infrastructure provisioning, and operational troubleshooting. Qualifications Location: This role is fully remote and open exclusively to candidates based in LATAM. Experience: 4+ years of proven experience in infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering. Strong proficiency with AWS services and modern cloud architecture patterns. Hands-on experience utilizing Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Solid understanding of Kubernetes concepts (deployments, services, ingress, RBAC, Helm charts) and containerization utilizing Docker. Proficiency in TypeScript and Bash scripting. Familiarity with standard CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD). Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs). Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure for AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI) or deploying LLMs in a production or near-production context. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills. Nice to Have: Experience coding in Golang. Knowledge of GitOps practices and tools (ArgoCD, Flux). Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK). AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD). Experience with service mesh implementations (Istio, Linkerd) and FinOps practices for cost optimization. Compensation Additional Information

title: Area Sales Manager Central Italy (Lazio and Abruzzo)
description: Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5,000 specialists. We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa, and other regions. The Global Business Development team is like-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems. The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection, and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe. Ajax Systems production includes 4 factories, 2 of which are located in Ukraine, 1 in Turkey, and 1 in Vietnam. At the same time, the company's certification according to the ISO 14001 standard ensures a minimal impact of production on the environment. The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements. The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax unwavering mission. Personality profile: 3+ years of experience in the electronic security industry or a similar industry. Proven sales experience in the Central Italy (Lazio and Abruzzo) region. Strong technical knowledge of electronic security systems, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, or fire alarm systems. Proven track record of being involved in the entire sales process, from identifying new business opportunities, developing proposals and presentations, negotiating, and closing deals. Developing and implementing successful sales strategies. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build relationships with customers, partners, and industry experts at an executive level. Strong analytical skills to analyze market trends, identify customer needs, and develop effective solutions. Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects and tasks simultaneously. Knowledge of the latest technologies and trends in electronic security, such as cloud-based solutions, IoT, and AI-based analytics. A strong combination of technical knowledge, sales expertise, and strong communication skills. Responsibilities: Develop and implement a strategic business development plan in Italy, aligned with company objectives and market trends. Identify, evaluate, and onboard new distributors and partners across the region, ensuring coverage in key markets and verticals. Identify and pursue new business opportunities that align with the company's growth strategy. Develop and maintain relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders. Conduct market research to identify new trends, opportunities, and potential risks. Analyze market data to develop and execute effective sales strategies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful delivery of products and services. Prepare and deliver presentations to potential clients and partners. Negotiate contracts and agreements with clients and partners. Manage and prioritize multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously. We offer: Competitive compensation that includes a base salary and performance-related bonuses. A product that sells itself. Freedom to make decisions and implement ideas. A zero bullshit culture. A strong and well-coordinated team of professionals. Ambitious tasks and challenges. Opportunity to work with the most recognized security system and develop your career. Let's become a part of the team that creates in Ukraine a smart and useful global product.
